items.text: ﴿قَالَ رَبِّ اشْرَحْ لِي صَدْرِي (٢٥) وَيَسِّرْ لِي أَمْرِي (٢٦) وَاحْلُلْ عُقْدَةً مِنْ لِسَانِي (٢٧) يَفْقَهُوا قَوْلِي (٢٨)﴾
items.translation: [Moses] said, "My Lord, expand for me my breast [with assurance] And ease for me my task And untie the knot from my tongue That they may understand my speech.

items.sectionEn: Surah Taa-Haa
items.text: ﴿فَتَعَالَى اللَّهُ الْمَلِكُ الْحَقُّ ۗ وَلَا تَعْجَلْ بِالْقُرْآنِ مِنْ قَبْلِ أَنْ يُقْضَىٰ إِلَيْكَ وَحْيُهُ ۖ وَقُلْ رَبِّ زِدْنِي عِلْمًا (١١٤)﴾
items.translation: So high [above all] is Allah, the Sovereign, the Truth. And, [O Muhammad], do not hasten with [recitation of] the Qur'an before its revelation is completed to you, and say, "My Lord, increase me in knowledge."

items.sectionEn: Surah Al-Anbiyaa
items.text: ﴿۞ وَأَيُّوبَ إِذْ نَادَىٰ رَبَّهُ أَنِّي مَسَّنِيَ الضُّرُّ وَأَنْتَ أَرْحَمُ الرَّاحِمِينَ (٨٣)﴾
items.translation: And [mention] Job, when he called to his Lord, "Indeed, adversity has touched me, and you are the Most Merciful of the merciful."

items.sectionEn: Surah Al-Anbiyaa
items.text: ﴿وَذَا النُّونِ إِذْ ذَهَبَ مُغَاضِبًا فَظَنَّ أَنْ لَنْ نَقْدِرَ عَلَيْهِ فَنَادَىٰ فِي الظُّلُمَاتِ أَنْ لَا إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا أَنْتَ سُبْحَانَكَ إِنِّي كُنْتُ مِنَ الظَّالِمِينَ (٨٧)﴾
items.translation: And [mention] the man of the fish, when he went off in anger and thought that We would not decree [anything] upon him. And he called out within the darknesses, "There is no deity except You; exalted are You. Indeed, I have been of the wrongdoers."

items.sectionEn: Surah Al-Anbiyaa
items.text: ﴿وَزَكَرِيَّا إِذْ نَادَىٰ رَبَّهُ رَبِّ لَا تَذَرْنِي فَرْدًا وَأَنْتَ خَيْرُ الْوَارِثِينَ (٨٩)﴾
items.translation: And [mention] Zechariah, when he called to his Lord, "My Lord, do not leave me alone [with no heir], while you are the best of inheritors."

items.sectionEn: Surah Al-Muminoon
items.text: ﴿وَقُلْ رَبِّ أَنْزِلْنِي مُنْزَلًا مُبَارَكًا وَأَنْتَ خَيْرُ الْمُنْزِلِينَ (٢٩)﴾
items.translation: And say, 'My Lord, let me land at a blessed landing place, and You are the best to accommodate [us].' "

items.sectionEn: Surah Al-Muminoon
items.text: ﴿وَقُلْ رَبِّ أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ هَمَزَاتِ الشَّيَاطِينِ (٩٧) وَأَعُوذُ بِكَ رَبِّ أَنْ يَحْضُرُونِ (٩٨)﴾
items.translation: And say, "My Lord, I seek refuge in You from the incitements of the devils, And I seek refuge in You, my Lord, lest they be present with me."

items.sectionEn: Surah Al-Muminoon
items.text: ﴿إِنَّهُ كَانَ فَرِيقٌ مِنْ عِبَادِي يَقُولُونَ رَبَّنَا آمَنَّا فَاغْفِرْ لَنَا وَارْحَمْنَا وَأَنْتَ خَيْرُ الرَّاحِمِينَ (١٠٩)﴾
items.translation: Indeed, there was a party of My servants who said, 'Our Lord, we have believed, so forgive us and have mercy upon us, and You are the best of the merciful.'

items.sectionEn: Surah Al-Muminoon
items.text: ﴿وَقُلْ رَبِّ اغْفِرْ وَارْحَمْ وَأَنْتَ خَيْرُ الرَّاحِمِينَ (١١٨)﴾
items.translation: And, [O Muhammad], say, "My Lord, forgive and have mercy, and You are the best of the merciful."

items.sectionEn: Surah Al-Furqaan
items.text: ﴿وَالَّذِينَ يَقُولُونَ رَبَّنَا اصْرِفْ عَنَّا عَذَابَ جَهَنَّمَ ۖ إِنَّ عَذَابَهَا كَانَ غَرَامًا (٦٥) إِنَّهَا سَاءَتْ مُسْتَقَرًّا وَمُقَامًا (٦٦)﴾
items.translation: And those who say, "Our Lord, avert from us the punishment of Hell. Indeed, its punishment is ever adhering; Indeed, it is evil as a settlement and residence."

items.sectionEn: Surah Al-Furqaan
items.text: ﴿وَالَّذِينَ يَقُولُونَ رَبَّنَا هَبْ لَنَا مِنْ أَزْوَاجِنَا وَذُرِّيَّاتِنَا قُرَّةَ أَعْيُنٍ وَاجْعَلْنَا لِلْمُتَّقِينَ إِمَامًا (٧٤)﴾
items.translation: And those who say, "Our Lord, grant us from among our wives and offspring comfort to our eyes and make us an example for the righteous."

items.sectionEn: Surah Ash-Shu'araa
items.text: ﴿رَبِّ هَبْ لِي حُكْمًا وَأَلْحِقْنِي بِالصَّالِحِينَ (٨٣) وَاجْعَلْ لِي لِسَانَ صِدْقٍ فِي الْآخِرِينَ (٨٤) وَاجْعَلْنِي مِنْ وَرَثَةِ جَنَّةِ النَّعِيمِ (٨٥)﴾
items.translation: [And he said], "My Lord, grant me authority and join me with the righteous. And grant me a reputation of honor among later generations. And place me among the inheritors of the Garden of Pleasure.

items.sectionEn: Surah An-Naml
items.text: ﴿فَتَبَسَّمَ ضَاحِكًا مِنْ قَوْلِهَا وَقَالَ رَبِّ أَوْزِعْنِي أَنْ أَشْكُرَ نِعْمَتَكَ الَّتِي أَنْعَمْتَ عَلَيَّ وَعَلَىٰ وَالِدَيَّ وَأَنْ أَعْمَلَ صَالِحًا تَرْضَاهُ وَأَدْخِلْنِي بِرَحْمَتِكَ فِي عِبَادِكَ الصَّالِحِينَ (١٩)﴾
items.translation: So [Solomon] smiled, amused at her speech, and said, "My Lord, enable me to be grateful for Your favor which You have bestowed upon me and upon my parents and to do righteousness of which You approve. And admit me by Your mercy into [the ranks of] Your righteous servants."

items.sectionEn: Surah Al-Qasas
items.text: ﴿قَالَ رَبِّ إِنِّي ظَلَمْتُ نَفْسِي فَاغْفِرْ لِي فَغَفَرَ لَهُ ۚ إِنَّهُ هُوَ الْغَفُورُ الرَّحِيمُ (١٦)﴾
items.translation: He said, "My Lord, indeed I have wronged myself, so forgive me," and He forgave him. Indeed, He is the Forgiving, the Merciful.

items.sectionEn: Surah Al-Qasas
items.text: ﴿فَسَقَىٰ لَهُمَا ثُمَّ تَوَلَّىٰ إِلَى الظِّلِّ فَقَالَ رَبِّ إِنِّي لِمَا أَنْزَلْتَ إِلَيَّ مِنْ خَيْرٍ فَقِيرٌ (٢٤)﴾
items.translation: So he watered [their flocks] for them; then he went back to the shade and said, "My Lord, indeed I am, for whatever good You would send down to me, in need."

items.sectionEn: Surah Al-Ankaboot
items.text: ﴿قَالَ رَبِّ انْصُرْنِي عَلَى الْقَوْمِ الْمُفْسِدِينَ (٣٠)﴾
items.translation: He said, "My Lord, support me against the corrupting people."

items.sectionEn: Surah As-Saaffaat
items.text: ﴿رَبِّ هَبْ لِي مِنَ الصَّالِحِينَ (١٠٠)﴾
items.translation: My Lord, grant me [a child] from among the righteous."

items.sectionEn: Surah Al-Ahqaf
items.text: ﴿وَوَصَّيْنَا الْإِنْسَانَ بِوَالِدَيْهِ إِحْسَانًا ۖ حَمَلَتْهُ أُمُّهُ كُرْهًا وَوَضَعَتْهُ كُرْهًا ۖ وَحَمْلُهُ وَفِصَالُهُ ثَلَاثُونَ شَهْرًا ۚ حَتَّىٰ إِذَا بَلَغَ أَشُدَّهُ وَبَلَغَ أَرْبَعِينَ سَنَةً قَالَ رَبِّ أَوْزِعْنِي أَنْ أَشْكُرَ نِعْمَتَكَ الَّتِي أَنْعَمْتَ عَلَيَّ وَعَلَىٰ وَالِدَيَّ وَأَنْ أَعْمَلَ صَالِحًا تَرْضَاهُ وَأَصْلِحْ لِي فِي ذُرِّيَّتِي ۖ إِنِّي تُبْتُ إِلَيْكَ وَإِنِّي مِنَ الْمُسْلِمِينَ (١٥)﴾
items.translation: And We have enjoined upon man, to his parents, good treatment. His mother carried him with hardship and gave birth to him with hardship, and his gestation and weaning [period] is thirty months. [He grows] until, when he reaches maturity and reaches [the age of] forty years, he says, "My Lord, enable me to be grateful for Your favor which You have bestowed upon me and upon my parents and to work righteousness of which You will approve and make righteous for me my offspring. Indeed, I have repented to You, and indeed, I am of the Muslims."

items.sectionEn: Surah Al-Hashr
items.text: ﴿وَالَّذِينَ جَاءُوا مِنْ بَعْدِهِمْ يَقُولُونَ رَبَّنَا اغْفِرْ لَنَا وَلِإِخْوَانِنَا الَّذِينَ سَبَقُونَا بِالْإِيمَانِ وَلَا تَجْعَلْ فِي قُلُوبِنَا غِلًّا لِلَّذِينَ آمَنُوا رَبَّنَا إِنَّكَ رَءُوفٌ رَحِيمٌ (١٠)﴾
items.translation: And [there is a share for] those who came after them, saying, "Our Lord, forgive us and our brothers who preceded us in faith and put not in our hearts [any] resentment toward those who have believed. Our Lord, indeed You are Kind and Merciful."

items.sectionEn: Surah Al-Mumtahana
items.text: ﴿رَبَّنَا لَا تَجْعَلْنَا فِتْنَةً لِلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا وَاغْفِرْ لَنَا رَبَّنَا ۖ إِنَّكَ أَنْتَ الْعَزِيزُ الْحَكِيمُ (٥)﴾
items.translation: Our Lord, make us not [objects of] torment for the disbelievers and forgive us, our Lord. Indeed, it is You who is the Exalted in Might, the Wise."

items.sectionEn: Surah Nooh
items.text: ﴿رَبِّ اغْفِرْ لِي وَلِوَالِدَيَّ وَلِمَنْ دَخَلَ بَيْتِيَ مُؤْمِنًا وَلِلْمُؤْمِنِينَ وَالْمُؤْمِنَاتِ وَلَا تَزِدِ الظَّالِمِينَ إِلَّا تَبَارًا (٢٨)﴾
items.translation: My Lord, forgive me and my parents and whoever enters my house a believer and the believing men and believing women. And do not increase the wrongdoers except in destruction."

items.sectionEn: Invocations in times of worry and grief
items.text: ((اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي عَبْدُكَ، ابْنُ عَبْدِكَ، ابْنُ أَمَتِكَ، نَاصِيَتِي بِيَدِكَ، مَاضٍ فِيَّ حُكْمُكَ، عَدْلٌ فِيَّ قَضَاؤُكَ، أَسْأَلُكَ بِكُلِّ اسْمٍ هُوَ لَكَ، سَمَّيْتَ بِهِ نَفْسَكَ، أَوْ أَنْزَلْتَهُ فِي كِتَابِكَ، أَوْ عَلَّمْتَهُ أَحَداً مِنْ خَلْقِكَ، أَوِ اسْتَأْثَرْتَ بِهِ فِي عِلْمِ الغَيْبِ عِنْدَكَ، أَنْ تَجْعَلَ القُرْآنَ رَبِيعَ قَلْبِي، وَنُورَ صَدْرِي، وَجَلاَءَ حُزْنِي، وَذَهَابَ هَمِّي)).
items.footnote: أحمد 1/391وصححه الألباني
items.translation: (O Allah, I am Your servant, son of Your servant, son of Your maidservant, my forelock is in Your hand (i.e. You have total mastery over), Your command over me is forever executed and Your decree over me is just. I ask You by every name belonging to You which You named Yourself with, or revealed in Your Book, or You taught to any of Your creation, or You have preserved in the knowledge of the unseen with You, that You make the Quran the life of my heart and the light of my breast, and a departure for my sorrow and a release for my anxiety.)
items.transliteration: (Allahumma innee AAabduk, ibnu AAabdik, ibnu amatik, nasiyatee biyadik, madin fiyya hukmuk, AAadlun fiyya qada-ok, as-aluka bikulli ismin huwa lak, sammayta bihi nafsak, aw anzaltahu fee kitabik, aw AAallamtahu ahadan min khalqik awis-ta/tharta bihi fee AAilmil-ghaybi AAindak, an tajAAalal-Qurana rabeeAAa qalbee, wanoora sadree, wajalaa huznee wathahaba hammee.)

items.sectionEn: Invocations in times of worry and grief
items.text: ((اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنَ الْهَمِّ وَالْحَزَنِ، وَالْعَجْزِ وَالْكَسَلِ، وَالْبُخْلِ وَالْجُبْنِ، وَضَلَعِ الدَّيْنِ وَغَلَبَةِ الرِّجَالِ)).
items.footnote: البخاري 7/158 كان رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم يكثر من هذا الدعاء.
items.translation: (O Allah, I take refuge in You from anxiety and sorrow, weakness and laziness, miserliness and cowardice, the burden of debts and from being over powered by men.)
items.transliteration: (Allahumma innee aAAoothu bika minal-hammi walhuzn, walAAajzi walkasali walbukhli waljubn, wadalAAid-dayni waghalabatir-rijal.)

items.sectionEn: Invocations for anguish
items.text: ((لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ اللَّهُ الْعَظِيمُ الْحَلِيمُ، لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ اللَّهُ رَبُّ الْعَرْشِ الْعَظِيمِ، لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ اللَّهُ رَبُّ السَّمَوَاتِ وَرَبُّ الْأَرْضِ وَرَبُّ الْعَرْشِ الْكَرِيمِ)).
items.footnote: البخاري 7/154ومسلم 4/ 2092
items.translation: (None has the right to be worshipped except Allah Forbearing. None has the right to be worshipped except Allah, Lord of the magnificent throne. None has the right to be worshipped except Allah, Lord of the heavens, Lord of the Earth and Lord of the noble throne.)
items.transliteration: (La ilaha illal-lahul-AAatheemul-haleem, la ilaha illal-lahu rabbul-AAarshil-AAatheem, la ilaha illal-lahu rabbus-samawati warabbul-ardi warabbul-AAarshil-kareem.)

items.sectionEn: Invocations for anguish
items.text: ((اللَّهُمَّ رَحْمَتَكَ أَرْجُو، فَلاَ تَكِلْنِي إِلَى نَفْسِي طَرْفَةَ عَيْنٍ، وَأَصْلِحْ لِي شَأْنِي كُلَّهُ، لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ أَنْتَ)).
items.footnote: أبو داود 4/324 وأحمد 5/42 وحسنه الألباني في صحيح أبو داود 3/ 959
items.translation: (O Allah, it is Your mercy that I hope for, so do not leave me in charge of my affairs even for a blink of an eye and rectify for me all of my affairs.None has the right to be worshipped except You.)
items.transliteration: (Allahumma rahmataka arjoo fala takilnee ila nafsee tarfata AAayn, wa-aslih lee sha/nee kullah, la ilaha illa ant.)

items.sectionEn: Invocations for anguish
items.text: ((لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ أَنْتَ سُبْحَانَكَ إِنِّي كُنْتُ مِنَ الظّالِمِينَ)).
items.footnote: الترمذي 5/529 والحاكم وصححه ووفقه الذهبي 1/505 وانظر صحيح الترمذي3/ 168
items.translation: (None has the right to be worshipped except You. How perfect You are, verily I was among the wrong-doers.)
items.transliteration: (La ilaha illa anta subhanaka innee kuntu minath-thalimeen.)

items.sectionEn: Invocations for anguish
items.text: ((اللَّهُ اللَّهُ رَبِّي لاَ أُشْرِكُ بِهِ شَيْئاً)).
items.footnote: أخرجه أبو داود 2/87 وانظر صحيح ابن ماجه 2/335
items.translation: (Allah, Allah is my Lord, I do not associate anything with Him.)
items.transliteration: (None has the right to be worshipped except You. How perfect You are, verily I was among the wrong-doers.)

items.sectionEn: Invocations for the settling of a debt
items.text: ((اللَّهُمَّ اكْفِنِي بِحَلاَلِكَ عَنْ حَرَامِكَ، وَأَغْنِنِي بِفَضْلِكِ عَمَّنْ سِوَاكَ)).
items.footnote: الترمذي 5/560 وانظر صحيح الترمذي3/ 180
items.translation: (O Allah, make what is lawful enough for me, as opposed to what is unlawful, and spare me by Your grace, of need of others.)
items.transliteration: (Allahummak-finee bihalalika AAan haramik, wa-aghninee bifadlika AAamman siwak.)

items.sectionEn: Invocations for the settling of a debt
items.text: ((اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنَ الْهَمِّ وَالْحَزَنِ، وَالْعَجْزِ وَالْكَسَلِ، وَالْبُخْلِ وَالْجُبْنِ، وَضَلَعِ الدَّيْنِ وَغَلَبَةِ الرِّجَالِ)).
items.footnote: البخاري7/ 158
items.translation: (O Allah, I take refuge in You from anxiety and sorrow, weakness and laziness, miserliness and cowardice, the burden of debts and from being over powered by men.)
items.transliteration: (Allahumma innee aAAoothu bika minal-hammi walhuzn, walAAajzi walkasal, walbukhl, waljubn, wadalAAid-dayni waghalabatir-rijal)

items.sectionEn: Invocation for when you find something becoming difficult for you
items.text: ((اللَّهُمَّ لاَ سَهْلَ إِلاَّ مَا جَعَلْتَهُ سَهْلاً، وَأَنْتَ تَجْعَلُ الْحَزْنَ إِذَا شِئْتَ سَهْلاً)).
items.footnote: رواة ابن حبان في صحيحه برقم 2427 (موارد) وابن السني برقم 351 وقال الحافظ هذا حديث صحيح وصححه عبد القادر الأرناؤوط في تخريج الأذكار للنووي ص106
items.translation: (O Allah, there is no ease except in that which You have made easy, and You make the difficulty, if You wish, easy.)
items.transliteration: (Allahumma la sahla illa ma jaAAaltahu sahla, wa-anta tajAAalul- hazana in shi'ta sahla.)

items.sectionAr: ما يقول ويفعل من أذنب ذنبا
items.sectionEn: What to say and do if you commit a sin
items.text: ((مَا مِنْ عَبْدٍ يُذنِبُ ذَنْباً فَيُحْسِنُ الطُّهُورَ، ثُمَّ يَقُومُ فَيُصَلِّي رَكْعَتَيْنِ، ثُمَّ يَسْتَغْفِرُ اللَّهَ إِلاَّ غَفَرَ اللَّهُ لَهُ)).
items.footnote: أبو داود 2/86 والترمذي 2/257 وصححه الألباني في صحيح أبي داود 1/ 283
items.translation: (Any servant who commits a sin and as a result, performs ablution, prays two units of prayer (i.e. two rakAAas) and then seeks Allah’s forgiveness, Allah would forgive him.)

items.sectionAr: دعاء لقاء العدو و ذي السلطان
items.sectionEn: Invocations for when you meet an adversary or a powerful ruler.
items.text: ((اللَّهُمَّ إِنَّا نَجْعَلُكَ فِي نُحُورِهِم، وَنَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ شُرُورِهِمْ)).
items.footnote: أبو داود 2/89 وصححه الحاكم ووافقه الذهبي 2/142
items.translation: (O Allah, we place You before them and we take refuge in You from their evil.)
items.transliteration: (Allahumma inna najAAaluka fee nuhoorihim wanaAAoothu bika min shuroorihim.)

items.sectionAr: دعاء لقاء العدو و ذي السلطان
items.sectionEn: Invocations for when you meet an adversary or a powerful ruler.
items.text: ((اللَّهُمَّ أَنْتَ عَضُدِي، وَأَنْتَ نَصِيرِي، بِكَ أَحُولُ وَبِكَ أَصُولُ، وَبِكَ أُقاتِلُ)).
items.footnote: أبو داود 3/42 والترمذي 5/572 ،وانظر صحيح الترمذي3/183
items.translation: (O Allah, You are my supporter and You are my helper, by You I move and by You I attack and by You I battle.)
items.transliteration: (Allahumma anta AAadudee, wa-anta naseeree, bika ajoolu wabika asoolu wabika oqatil)

items.sectionAr: دعاء لقاء العدو و ذي السلطان
items.sectionEn: Invocations for when you meet an adversary or a powerful ruler.
items.text: ((حَسْبُنا اللَّهُ وَنِعْمَ الْوَكِيلُ)).
items.footnote: البخاري 5/172
items.translation: (Allah is sufficient for us, and how fine a trustee (He is).)
items.transliteration: (Hasbunal-lahu waniAAmal-wakeel.)

items.sectionEn: Invocations against the oppression of rulers
items.text: ((اللَّهُمَّ ربَّ السَّمَوَاتِ السَّبْعِ، وَرَبَّ الْعَرْشِ الْعَظِيمِ، كُنْ لِي جَاراً مِنْ فُلاَنِ بْنِ فُلاَنٍ، وَأَحْزَابِهِ مِنْ خَلاَئِقِكَ، أَنْ يَفْرُطَ عَلَيَّ أَحَدٌ مِنْهُمْ أَوْ يَطْغَى، عَزَّ جَارُكَ، وَجَلَّ ثَنَاؤُكَ، وَلاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ أَنْتَ)).
items.footnote: البخاري في الأدب المفرد برقم 707 وصححه الألباني وفي صحيح الأدب المفرد برقم 545
items.translation: O Allah, Lord of the seven heavens, Lord of the Magnificent Throne, be for me a support against [such and such a person] and his helpers from among your creatures, lest any of them abuse me or do me wrong. Mighty is your patronage and glorious are your praises. There is none worthy of worship but you.
items.transliteration: Allaahumma rabbas-samaawaatis-sab'i, wa Rabbal-'Arshil-'Adheem, Kun lee jaaran min (here you mention the person's name) wa 'ahzabihi min khalaa'iqika, 'an yafruta 'alayya 'ahadun minhum 'aw yatghaa,'Azza jaaruka, wa jalla thanaa'uka, wa laa 'ilaaha 'illaa 'Anta.

items.sectionEn: Invocations against the oppression of rulers
items.text: ((اللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ، اللَّهُ أَعَزُّ مِنْ خَلْقِهِ جَمِيعاً، اللَّهُ أَعَزُّ مِمَّا أَخَافُ وَأَحْذَرُ، أَعُوذُ بِاللَّهِ الَّذِي لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ هُوَ، الْمُمْسِكِ السَّمَوَاتِ السَّبْعِ أَنْ يَقَعْنَ عَلَى الْأَرْضِ إِلاَّ بِإِذْنِهِ، مِنْ شَرِّ عَبْدِكَ فُلاَنٍ، وَجُنُودِهِ وَأَتْبَاعِهِ وَأَشْيَاعِهِ، مِنْ الْجِنِّ وَالإِنْسِ، اللَّهُمَّ كُنْ لِي جَاراً مِنْ شَرِّهِمْ، جَلَّ ثَنَاؤُكَ وَعَزَّ جَارُكَ، وَتَبَارَكَ اسْمُكَ، وَلاَ إِلَهَ غَيْرُكَ)) (ثلاثَ مرَّاتٍ).
items.footnote: البخاري في الأدب المفرد برقم 708 وصححه الألباني وفي صحيح الأدب المفرد برقم
items.translation: Allah is the Most Great, Mightier than all His creation. He is Mightier than what fear and dread. I seek refuge in Allah, Who there is none worthy of worship but Him. He is the One Who holds the seven heavens from falling upon the earth except by His command. [I seek refuge in You Allah] from the evil of Your slave [name of the person], and his helpers, his followers and his supporters from among the jinn and mankind. O Allah, be my support against their evil. Glorious Your praises and mighty is Your patronage. Blessed is Your Name, there is no true God but You. (Recite three times in Arabic)
items.transliteration: Allaahu Akbar, Allaahu 'a'azzu min khalqihi jamee'an, Allaahu 'a'azzu mimmaa 'akhaafu wa 'ahdharu, 'a'oothu billaahil-lathee laa ilaaha illaa huwa, almumsikis-samaawaatis-sab'i 'an yaqa'na 'alaal-'ardhi 'illaa bi'ithnihi, min sharri 'abdika (name of the person) wa junoodihi wa 'atbaa'ihi wa ashyaa'ihi minal-jinni wal'insi, Allaahumma kun lee jaaran min sharrihim, Jalla thanaa'uka wa 'azza aaruka, wa tabaarakasmuka, wa laa ilaaha ghayruka.

items.sectionEn: Invocation against an enemy
items.text: ((اللَّهُمَّ مُنْزِلَ الْكِتَابِ، سَرِيعَ الْحِسَابِ، اهْزِمِ الأَحْزَابَ، اللَّهُمَّ اهزِمْهُمْ وَزَلْزِلْهُمْ)).
items.footnote: مسلم 3/1362
items.translation: (O Allah, Revealer of the Book, Swift at reckoning, defeat the confederates. O Allah, defeat them and convulse them.)
items.transliteration: (Allahumma munzilal-kitab, sareeAAal-hisab, ihzimil-ahzab, allahummah-zimhum wazalzilhum.)

items.sectionEn: What to say if you fear people may harm you
items.text: ((اللَّهُمَّ اكْفِنِيهِمْ بِمَا شِئْتَ)).
items.footnote: مسلم 4/2300
items.translation: (O Allah, protect me from them with what You choose.)
items.transliteration: (Allahummak-fineehim bima shi/.)

items.sectionAr: دعاء من أصابه وسوسة في الإيمان
items.sectionEn: Invocations for if you are stricken by doubt in your faith
items.text: ((يَسْتَعِيذُ بِاللَّهِ و يَنْتَهِي عَمَّا شك فِيهِ)).
items.footnote:
البخاري مع الفتح 6/336 ومسلم 1/120
البخاري مع الفتح 6/336 ومسلم 1/120
items.transliteration: (Say:) I seek refuge in Allah. (Then you should desist from doing what you are in doubt about.)

items.sectionAr: دعاء من أصابه وسوسة في الإيمان
items.sectionEn: Invocations for if you are stricken by doubt in your faith
items.text: ((يَقُولُ: ((آمَنْتُ بِاللَّهِ وَرُسُلِهِ)).
items.footnote: مسلم 1/ 120
items.translation: (He should say: (I have believed in Allah and His Messenger.))
items.transliteration: (He should say: ( Amantu billahi warusulih.))

items.sectionAr: دعاء من أصابه وسوسة في الإيمان
items.sectionEn: Invocations for if you are stricken by doubt in your faith
items.text: ((يَقْرَأُ قَوْلَهُ تَعَالَى: ﴿هُوَ الْأوَّلُ وَالْآخِرُ وَالظّاهِرُ وَالْباطِنُ وَهُوَ بِكُلِّ شَيْءٍ عَلِيمٌ﴾)).
items.footnote: سورة الحديد ، الآية :3 .أبو داود 4/329 وحسنه الألباني في صحيح أبو داود 3/962
items.translation: (He should also recite the following verse: (He is The First and The Last, Aththahir and Al-Batin and He knows well all things.)(ththahir: Indicates the greatness of His attributes and the insignificance of every single creation in respect to His greatness and Highness, for He is above all of His creation as regards His essence and attributes.)(Al-Batin: Indicates His awareness and knowledge of all secrets, of that which is in the hearts and the most intimate of things just as it indicates His closeness and nearness to all in a manner which befits His majesty.))
items.transliteration: (He should also recite the following verse: ( Huwa al-awwalu, waal-akhiru, waalththahiru waalbatinu wahuwa bikulli shayin AAaleem))

items.sectionAr: دعاء الوسوسة في الصلاة و القراءة
items.sectionEn: Invocation against the distractions of Satan during the prayer and recitation of the Quran
items.text: ((أَعُوذُ بِاللَّهِ مِنَ الشَّيطَانِ الرَّجِيمِ، وَاتْفُلْ عَلَى يَسَارِكَ (ثلاثاً))).
items.footnote: مسلم 4/1729 من حديث عثمان بن العاص رضي الله عنه وفيه ففعلت ذلك فأذهبه الله عني
items.translation: (othman Ibn Al-AAas narrated: I said ‘O Messenger of Allah, verily the devil comes between me and my prayer and recitation making me confused’ The Messenger of Allah replied ‘That is a devil called Khanzab, so if you sense his presence then seek refuge in Allah from him and spit (A form of spitting comprising mainly of air with little spittle) on your left side three times.)

items.sectionEn: Invocations against the Devil and his promptings
items.text: ((الْاسْتِعَاذَةُ بِاللَّهِ مِنْهُ)).
items.footnote: أبو داود 1/206 والترمذي وانظر صحيح الترمذي 1/77 وانظر سورة المؤمنون آية 98-99
items.translation: Seeking refuge from him.

items.sectionEn: Invocations against the Devil and his promptings
items.text: ((الْأَذَانُ)).
items.footnote: مسلم 1/ 291 والبخاري 1/151
items.translation: The Adhaan [call to prayer].

items.sectionEn: Invocations against the Devil and his promptings
items.text: ((الْأَذْكَارُ وَقِرَاءَةُ الْقُرْآنِ)).
items.footnote: لاتجعلوا بيوتكم مقابر إن الشيطان ينفر من البيت الذي تقرأ فيه سورة البقرة رواه مسلم 1/539 ومما يطرد الشيطان أذكار الصباح والمساء ، والنوم والاستيقاظ ، وأذكار دخول المنزل والخروج منه وأذكار دخول المسجد والخروج منه وغير ذلك من الأذكار المشروعة مثل قراءة آية الكرسي عند النوم ، والآيتين الأخيرتين من سورة البقرة ، ومن قال لا إله إلا الله وحده لا شريك له ،له الملك وله الحمد وهو على كل شيء قدير مائة مرة كانت له حرزاً من الشيطان يومه كله ،وكذا الأذان يطرد الشيطان
items.translation: (Recitation of the Quran and the authentic texts of remembrance and supplications.)(e.g. ‘Do not make your homes like the graveyards, indeed the devils flee from the house in which soorat Al-Baqarah has been read’ related by Muslim 1/539, also supplication and remembrance for the morning & evening, before sleep, when getting up, entering and leaving the toilet, entering and leaving the mosque, the recitation of ayat Al-kursiyy and the last two verses of soorat Al-Baqarah before sleeping, the athan…etc.)

items.sectionAr: الدعاء حينما يقع ما لا يرضاه أو غلب على أمره
items.sectionEn: Invocation for when something you dislike happens, or for when you fail to achieve what you attempt to do
items.text: ((قَدَرُ اللَّهُ وَمَا شَاءَ فَعَلَ)).
items.footnote: المؤمن القوي خير وأحب إلى الله من المؤمن الضعف وفي كل خير ،احرص على ما ينفعك واستعن بالله ولا تعجز وإن أصابك شيء فلا تقل لو أني فعلت كذا وكذا ولكن قل قدر الله وما شاء فعل فإن لو تفتح عمل الشيطان .مسلم 4/2052
items.translation: (Allah has decreed and what He wills, He does.)(for verily ‘If’ lets in the work of the devil.)
items.transliteration: (Qaddaral-lah, wama shaa faAAal.)

items.sectionEn: Repentance and seeking forgiveness
items.text: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم: ((وَاللَّهِ إِنِّي لأَسْتَغفِرُ اللَّهَ وَأَتُوبُ إِلَيْهِ فِي الْيَوْمِ أَكْثَرَ مِنْ سَبْعِينَ مَرَّةٍ)).
items.footnote: البخاري مع الفتح 11/101
items.translation: (The Messenger of Allah said: ‘By Allah, I seek forgiveness and repent to Allah, more than seventy times a day.)

items.sectionEn: Repentance and seeking forgiveness
items.text: وَقَالَ صلى الله عليه وسلم: ((يَا أَيُّهَا النَّاسُ تُوبُوا إِلَى اللَّهِ فَإِنِّي أَتُوبُ فِي الْيَوْمِ إِلَيْهِ مِائَةَ مَرَّةٍ)).
items.footnote: مسلم 4/2076
items.translation: (He also said: ‘O People, Repent! Verily I repent to Allah, a hundred times a day.)

items.sectionEn: Repentance and seeking forgiveness
items.text: وَقَالَ صلى الله عليه وسلم: ((مَنْ قَالَ أَسْتَغْفِرُ اللَّهَ الْعَظيمَ الَّذِي لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ هُوَ الْحَيُّ القَيّوُمُ وَأَتُوبُ إِلَيهِ، غَفَرَ اللَّهُ لَهُ وَإِنْ كَانَ فَرَّ مِنَ الزَّحْفِ)).
items.footnote: أخرجه أبو داود 2/85 والترمذي 5/569 والحاكم وصححه ووافقه الذهبي 1/511 وصححه الألباني . انظر صحيح الترمذي 3/182 وجامع الأصول لأحاديث الرسول صلى الله عيه وسلم 4/389 – 390 بتحقيق الأرناؤوط
items.translation: (He also said: ‘Whoever says:(I seek Allah’s forgiveness, besides whom, none has the right to be worshipped except He, The Ever Living, The Self-Subsisting and Supporter of all, and I turn to Him in repentance.) Allah would forgive him even if he was one who fled during the advance of an army.)
items.transliteration: (He also said: ‘Whoever says:(Astaghfirul-lahal-lathee la ilaha illa huwal-hayyul-qayyoomu wa-atoobu ilayh.) Allah would forgive him even if he was one who fled during the advance of an army.)

items.sectionEn: Repentance and seeking forgiveness
items.text: وَقَالَ صلى الله عليه وسلم: ((أَقْرَبُ مَا يَكُونُ الرَّبُّ مِنَ الْعَبْدِ فِي جَوْفِ اللَّيْلِ الآخِرِ فَإِنِ اسْتَطَعْتَ أَنْ تَكُونَ مِمَّنْ يَذْكُرُ اللَّهَ فِي تِلْكَ السَّاعَةِ فَكُنْ)).
items.footnote: أخرجه الترمذي والنسائي 1/279 والحاكم وانظر صحيح الترمذي 3/183 وجامع الأصول بتحقيق الأرناؤوط 4/144
items.translation: (He said: ‘The nearest the Lord comes to His servant is in the middle of the night, so if you are able to be of those who remember Allah at that time, then be so.)

items.sectionEn: Repentance and seeking forgiveness
items.text: وَقَالَ صلى الله عليه وسلم: ((أَقْرَبُ مَا يَكُونُ الْعَبْدُ مِنْ رَبِّهِ وَهُوَ سَاجِدٌ فَأَكثِرُوا الدُّعَاءَ)).
items.footnote: مسلم 1/350
items.translation: (He also said: ‘The nearest a servant is to his Lord is when he is prostrating, so supplicate much therein.)

items.sectionEn: Repentance and seeking forgiveness
items.text: وَقَالَ صلى الله عليه وسلم: ((إِنَّهُ لَيُغَانُ عَلَى قَلْبِي وَإِنِّي لأَسْتَغْفِرُ اللَّهَ فِي الْيَوْمِ مِائَةَ مَرَّةٍ)).
items.footnote: أخرجه مسلم 4/2075 قال ابن الأثير : ( ليُغان على قلبي ) أي ليغطى ويغشى والمراد : السهو ؛ لأنه كان صلى الله عيه وسلم لا يزال في مزيد من الذكر والقربة ودوام المراقبة فإذا سها عن شيء منها في بعض الأوقات ،أو نسي ،عدهُ ذنباً على نفسه ففزع إلى الاستغفار . انظر جامع الأصول 4/386
items.translation: (He also said: ‘verily my heart becomes preoccupied, and verily I seek Allah’s forgiveness a hundred times a day.)(preoccupied: i.e. in a state of ‘forgetfulness’. The Prophet always used to increase in his remembrance of his Lord, in attaining a nearness to Allah and having consciousness of Allah to the extent that if this intensity lessened in anyway, he would regard it as a sin and would then race to seek forgiveness from Allah.)

items.sectionAr: فضل التسبيح و التحميد، و التهليل، و التكبير
items.sectionEn: The excellence of remembering Allah
items.text: قَالَ صلى الله عليه وسلم مَنْ قَالَ: سُبْحَانَ اللَّهِ وَبِحَمْدِهِ فِي يَوْمٍ مِائَةَ مَرَّةٍ حُطَّتْ خَطَايَاهُ وَلَوْ كَانَتْ مِثْلَ زَبَدِ الْبَحْر)).
items.footnote: البخاري 7/168 ومسلم 4/ 2071 ، وانظر :فضل من قالها مائة مرة إذا أصبح وإذا أمسى
items.translation: (Whoever says:(How perfect Allah is and I praise Him.) a hundred times during the day, his sins are wiped away, even if they are like the foam of the sea.)
items.transliteration: (Whoever says:(Subhanal-lahi wabihamdih.) a hundred times during the day, his sins are wiped away, even if they are like the foam of the sea.)

items.sectionAr: فضل التسبيح و التحميد، و التهليل، و التكبير
items.sectionEn: The excellence of remembering Allah
items.text: وَقَالَ صلى الله عليه وسلم: ((مَنْ قَالَ لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ اللَّهُ وَحْدَهُ لاَ شَرِيكَ لَهُ، لَهُ الْمُلْكُ، وَلَهُ الْحَمْدُ، وَهُوَ عَلَى كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيرٌ عَشْرَ مِرَارٍ، كَانَ كَمَنْ أَعْتَقَ أَرْبَعَةَ أَنْفُسٍ مِنْ وَلَدِ إِسْمَاعِيلَ)).
items.footnote: البخاري 7/67 ومسلم بلفظه 4/2071 وانظر فضل من قالها في اليوم مائة مرة
items.translation: (Abu Hurayrah reported that the Messenger of Allah said: ‘Whoever says: (None has the right to be worshipped except Allah, alone, without partner. To Him belongs all sovereignty and praise and He is over all things omnipotent.) a hundred times during the day, has the reward of freeing ten slaves, a hundred good deeds are recorded for him and a hundred bad deeds are wiped away and he has gained refuge from the devil that day until evening and none shall come with anything better except someone who has done more.)
items.transliteration: (Abu Hurayrah reported that the Messenger of Allah said: ‘Whoever says: (La ilaha illal-lahu wahdahu la shareeka lah, lahul-mulku walahul-hamd, wahuwa AAala kulli shayin qadeer.) a hundred times during the day, has the reward of freeing ten slaves, a hundred good deeds are recorded for him and a hundred bad deeds are wiped away and he has gained refuge from the devil that day until evening and none shall come with anything better except someone who has done more.)

items.sectionAr: فضل التسبيح و التحميد، و التهليل، و التكبير
items.sectionEn: The excellence of remembering Allah
items.text: وَقَالَ صلى الله عليه وسلم: ((كَلِمَتَانِ خَفِيفَتَانِ عَلَى اللِّسَانِ، ثَقِيلَتَانِ فِي الْمِيزَانِ، حَبِيبَتَانِ إِلَى الرَّحْمَنِ: سُبْحَانَ اللَّهِ وَبِحَمْدِهِ، سُبْحانَ اللَّهِ الْعَظِيمِ)).
items.footnote: البخاري 7/167ومسلم 4/2072
items.translation: (Aboo Hurayrah reported that the Messenger of Allah said:’(There are) Two words, (which are ) light on the tongue, heavy on the Scale and beloved to The Most Gracious: (How perfect Allah is and I praise Him. How perfect Allah is, The Supreme.))
items.transliteration: (Aboo Hurayrah reported that the Messenger of Allah said:’(There are) Two words, (which are ) light on the tongue, heavy on the Scale and beloved to The Most Gracious: (Subhanal-lahi wabihamdih, wasubhanal-lahil-AAatheem.))

items.sectionAr: فضل التسبيح و التحميد، و التهليل، و التكبير
items.sectionEn: The excellence of remembering Allah
items.text: وَقَالَ صلى الله عليه وسلم: ((لَأَنْ أَقُولَ سُبْحَانَ اللَّهِ، وَالْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ، وَلاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ اللَّهُ، وَاللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ، أَحَبُّ إِلَيَّ مِمَّا طَلَعَتْ عَلَيْهِ الشَّمسُ)).
items.footnote: مسلم 4/2072
items.translation: (Aboo Hurayrah reported that the Messenger of Allah said: ‘Saying: (How perfect Allah is, and all praise is for Allah. None has the right to be worshipped except Allah, and Allah is the greatest.) is more beloved to me than everything the sun has risen over.)
items.transliteration: (Aboo Hurayrah reported that the Messenger of Allah said: ‘Saying: (Subhanal-lah, walhamdu lillah, la ilaha illal-lah wallahu akbar.) is more beloved to me than everything the sun has risen over.)

items.sectionAr: فضل التسبيح و التحميد، و التهليل، و التكبير
items.sectionEn: The excellence of remembering Allah
items.text: وَقَالَ صلى الله عليه وسلم: ((أَيَعْجِزُ أَحَدُكُم أَنْ يَكْسِبَ كُلَّ يَوْمٍ أَلْفَ حَسَنَةٍ)) فَسَأَلَهُ سَائِلٌ مِنْ جُلَسَائِهِ كَيْفَ يَكْسِبُ أَحَدُنَا أَلْفَ حَسَنَةٍ؟ قَالَ: ((يُسَبِّحُ مِائَةَ تَسْبِيحَةٍ، فَيُكتَبُ لَهُ أَلْفُ حَسَنَةٍ أَوْ يُحَطُّ عَنْهُ أَلْفُ خَطِيئَةٍ)).
items.footnote: مسلم 4/2073
items.translation: (Sa’d said: ‘We were sitting with the Messenger of Allah , and he said: ‘Are any of you unable to gain a thousand good deeds each day?’ Somebody then asked him : How does one achieve a thousand good deeds? He replied: ‘He should say: (How perfect Allah is.) one hundred times, for a thousand good deeds are recorded for him or a thousand bad deeds are wiped away.)
items.transliteration: (Sa’d said: ‘We were sitting with the Messenger of Allah , and he said: ‘Are any of you unable to gain a thousand good deeds each day?’ Somebody then asked him : How does one achieve a thousand good deeds? He replied: ‘He should say: (Subhanal-lah.) one hundred times, for a thousand good deeds are recorded for him or a thousand bad deeds are wiped away.)

items.sectionAr: فضل التسبيح و التحميد، و التهليل، و التكبير
items.sectionEn: The excellence of remembering Allah
items.text: ((مَنْ قَالَ: سُبْحَانَ اللَّهِ الْعَظِيمِ وَبِحَمْدِهِ غُرِسَتْ لَهُ نَخْلَةٌ فِي الْجَنَّةِ)).
items.footnote: أخرجه الترمذي 5/511 والحاكم 1/501 وصححه ووافقه الذهبي ، وانظر صحيح الجامع 5/531 وصحيح الترمذي 3/160
items.translation: (Jabbir related that the Prophet said: ‘Whoever says: (How perfect Allah is . The Supreme, and I praise Him.) a palm tree is planted for him in paradise.)
items.transliteration: (Jabbir related that the Prophet said: ‘Whoever says: (Subhanal-lahil-AAatheemi wabihamdih.) a palm tree is planted for him in paradise.)

items.sectionAr: فضل التسبيح و التحميد، و التهليل، و التكبير
items.sectionEn: The excellence of remembering Allah
items.text: وَقَالَ صلى الله عليه وسلم: ((يَا عَبْدَ اللَّهِ بْنَ قَيْسٍ أَلاَ أَدُلُّكَ عَلَى كَنْزٍ مِنْ كُنُوزِ الْجَنَّةِ))؟ فَقُلْتُ: بَلَى يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ، قَالَ: ((قُلْ لاَ حَوْلَ وَلاَ قُوَّةَ إِلاَّ بِاللَّهِ)).
items.footnote: البخاري مع الفتح 11/ 213 ومسلم 4/2076
items.translation: (AAabdullah Ibn Qays related that the Prophet said to him: ‘ O ‘AAabdullah Ibn Qays, shall I not inform you of a treasure from the treasures of paradise?’ He then said: ‘Say: (There is no might nor power except with Allah.))
items.transliteration: (AAabdullah Ibn Qays related that the Prophet said to him: ‘ O ‘AAabdullah Ibn Qays, shall I not inform you of a treasure from the treasures of paradise?’ He then said: ‘Say: (La hawla wala quwwata illa billah.))

items.sectionAr: فضل التسبيح و التحميد، و التهليل، و التكبير
items.sectionEn: The excellence of remembering Allah
items.text: وَقَالَ صلى الله عليه وسلم: ((أَحَبُّ الْكَلاَمِ إِلَى اللَّهِ أَرْبَعٌ: سُبْحَانَ اللَّهِ، وَالْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ، وَلاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ اللَّهُ، وَاللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ، لاَ يَضُرُّكَ بِأَيِّهِنَّ بَدَأتَ)).
items.footnote: مسلم 3/1685
items.translation: (the most beloved words to Allah are four: (How perfect Allah is, all praise is for Allah. None has the right to be worshipped except Allah and Allah is the greatest.))(it does not matter which of them you start with.)
items.transliteration: (the most beloved words to Allah are four: (Subhanal-lah, walhamdu lillah, wala ilaha illal-lah, wallahu akbar.))(it does not matter which of them you start with.)

items.sectionAr: فضل التسبيح و التحميد، و التهليل، و التكبير
items.sectionEn: The excellence of remembering Allah
items.text: جَاءَ أَعْرَابِيٌّ إِلَى رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَقَالَ: عَلِّمْنِي كَلاماً أَقُولُهُ: قَالَ: ((قُلْ: لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ اللَّهُ وَحْدَهُ لاَ شَرِيكَ لَهُ، اللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ كَبِيراً، وَالْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ كَثِيراً، سُبْحَانَ اللَّهِ رَبِّ العَالَمِينَ، لاَ حَوْلَ وَلاَ قُوَّةَ إِلاَّ بِاللَّهِ الْعَزِيزِ الْحَكِيمِ)) قَالَ: فَهَؤُلاَءِ لِرَبِّي، فَمَا لِي؟ قَالَ: ((قُلْ: اللَّهُمَّ اغْفِرْ لِي، وَارْحَمْنِي، وَاهْدِنِي، وَارْزُقْنِي)).
items.footnote: مسلم 4/ 2072 وزاد أبو داود : فلما ولى الأعرابي قال النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم : لقد ملأ يديه من الخير 1/ 220
items.translation: (SaAAd Ibn Abee Waqqas narrated that a man came to the Messenger of Allah and said to him: ‘Teach me something which I should say?’ He said: ‘Say: (None has the right to be worshipped except Allah, alone without partener. Allah is most great and much praise is for Allah. How perfect Allah is, Lord of the worlds. There is no might nor power except with Allah, The Exalted in might, The Wise.) the man then said: ‘These are for my Lord, and what is for me?’ He replied: ‘Say:(O Allah, forgive me, have mercy upon me, guide me and grant me sustenance.))
items.transliteration: (SaAAd Ibn Abee Waqqas narrated that a man came to the Messenger of Allah and said to him: ‘Teach me something which I should say?’ He said: ‘Say: (La ilaha illal-lah, wahdahu la shareeka lah, Allahu akbaru kabeera, walhamdu lillahi katheera, subhanal-lahi rabbil-AAalameen, la hawla wala quwwata illa billahil-AAazeezil-hakeem.) the man then said: ‘These are for my Lord, and what is for me?’ He replied: ‘Say:(Allahummagh-fir lee, warhamnee, wahdinee, warzuqnee.))

items.sectionAr: فضل التسبيح و التحميد، و التهليل، و التكبير
items.sectionEn: The excellence of remembering Allah
items.text: كَانَ الرَّجُلُ إِذَا أَسْلَمَ عَلَّمَهُ النَّبيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم الصَّلاَةَ ثُمَّ أَمَرَهُ أَنْ يَدْعُوَ بِهَؤُلاَءِ الْكَلِمَاتِ: ((اللَّهُمَّ اغْفِرِ لِي، وَارْحَمْنِي، وَاهْدِنِي، وَعَافِنِي وَارْزُقْنِي)).
items.footnote: مسلم 4/2073 وفي رواية لمسلم فإن هؤلاء تجمع لك ديناك وآخرتك
items.translation: (Tariq Al-AshjaAAee said: ‘When someone would embrace Islam, the Prophet would teach him how to perform prayer and then order him to supplicate with the following words: (O Allah, forgive me, have mercy upon me, guide me, give me health and grant me sustenance.))
items.transliteration: (Tariq Al-AshjaAAee said: ‘When someone would embrace Islam, the Prophet would teach him how to perform prayer and then order him to supplicate with the following words: (Allahummagh-fir lee, warhamnee, wahdinee, waAAafinee warzuqnee.))

items.sectionAr: فضل التسبيح و التحميد، و التهليل، و التكبير
items.sectionEn: The excellence of remembering Allah
items.text: ((إِنَّ أَفْضَلَ الدُّعَاءِ الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ، وَأَفْضَلَ الذِّكْرِ لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ اللَّهُ)).
items.footnote: الترمذي 5/462 وابن ماجه 2/1249 والحاكم 1/503 وصححه ووافقه الذهبي وانظر صحيح الجامع 1/ 362
items.translation: (Jabir Ibn ‘AAabdullah related that the Messenger of Allah said: ‘Verily, the best supplication is: (All praise is for Allah.) and indeed, the best form of remembrance is: (None has the right to be worshipped except Allah.))
items.transliteration: (Jabir Ibn ‘AAabdullah related that the Messenger of Allah said: ‘Verily, the best supplication is: (Alhamdu lillah) and indeed, the best form of remembrance is: (La ilaha illal-lah.))

items.sectionAr: فضل التسبيح و التحميد، و التهليل، و التكبير
items.sectionEn: The excellence of remembering Allah
items.text: الباقيات الصالحات : سبحان الله والحمد لله ، ولا إله إلا الله ،والله أكبر ،و لا حول ولا قوة إلا بالله
items.footnote: أحمد برقم 513 بترتيب أحمد شاكر وإسناده صحيح وانظر مجمع الزوائد 1/297، وعزاه ابن حجر في بلوغ المرام من رواية أبي سعيد إلىالنسائي وقال :صححه ابن حبان والحاكم
items.translation: The good deeds which endure are 'Glorified is Allah', and 'The praise is for Allah', and 'but There is none worthy of worship Allah', and 'Allah is the Most Great', and 'There is no power and no might except by Allah'
items.transliteration: The good deeds which endure are 'Subhaanallaah.', and 'Walhamdulillaah.', and 'Wa laa ilaaha illallaah'., and 'Wallaahu Akbar',and 'Wa laa hawla wa laa guwawala illaa billaah'.

items.sectionEn: How the Prophet glorified Allah
items.text: عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عَمْرٍو رضي الله عنه قَالَ: ((رَأَيْتُ النَّبيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَعْقِدُ التَّسْبِيحَ)) وفي زيادةٍ: ((بِيَمِينِهِ)).
items.footnote: أخرجه أبو داود بلفظه 2/81 والترمذي 5/521 وانظر صحيح الجامع 4/271 برقم 4865
items.translation: (Tasbeeh, it means here, to say: (Subhanal-lah, alhamdu lillah, Allahu akbar.)) (AAabdullah Ibn AAamr said: ’I saw the prophet make tasbeeh with his right hand.)

items.sectionAr: فضل الصلاة على النبي صلى الله عليه و سلم
items.sectionEn: The excellence of asking for Allah's blessings upon the Prophet pbuh
items.text: قَالَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم: ((مَنْ صَلَّى عَلَيَّ صَلاَةً صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ بِهَا عَشْراً)).
items.footnote: أخرجه مسلم 1/288
items.translation: (The Prophet (PBUH) said: ‘Whoever sends a prayer upon me, Allah sends ten upon him.)

items.sectionAr: فضل الصلاة على النبي صلى الله عليه و سلم
items.sectionEn: The excellence of asking for Allah's blessings upon the Prophet pbuh
items.text: وَقَالَ صلى الله عليه وسلم: ((لاَ تَجْعَلُوا قَبْرِي عِيداً وَصَلُّوا عَلَيَّ؛ فَإِنَّ صَلاَتَكُم تَبْلُغُنِي حَيْثُ كُنْتُمْ)).
items.footnote: أبو داود 2/218 وأحمد 2/367 وصححه الألباني في صحيح أبي داود 2/ 383
items.translation: (He (PBUH) also said: ‘Do not take my grave as a place of habitual ceremony. Send prayers upon me, for verily your prayers reach me wherever you are.)

items.sectionAr: فضل الصلاة على النبي صلى الله عليه و سلم
items.sectionEn: The excellence of asking for Allah's blessings upon the Prophet pbuh
items.text: وَقَالَ صلى الله عليه وسلم: ((الْبَخِيلُ مَنْ ذُكِرْتُ عِنْدَهُ فَلَمْ يُصَلِّ عَلَيَّ)).
items.footnote: الترمذي 5/551 وغيره وانظر صحيح الجامع 3/ 25 وصحيح الترمذي 3/ 177
items.translation: (He (PBUH) also said: ‘A miser is one whom when I am mentioned to him, fails to send prayers upon me.)

items.sectionAr: فضل الصلاة على النبي صلى الله عليه و سلم
items.sectionEn: The excellence of asking for Allah's blessings upon the Prophet pbuh
items.text: وَقَالَ صلى الله عليه وسلم:((إِنَّ لِلَّهِ مَلاَئِكَةً سَيَّاحِينَ فِي الْأَرْضِ يُبَلِّغُونِي مِنْ أُمَّتِي السَّلاَمَ)).
items.footnote: النسائي ،والحاكم 2/421 وصححه الألباني في صحيح النسائي 1/274
items.translation: The Prophet [PBUH] said:'Indeed Allah has angels who roam the earth and they convey to me the greetings (or prayers of peace) of my 'Ummah (nation).

items.sectionAr: فضل الصلاة على النبي صلى الله عليه و سلم
items.sectionEn: The excellence of asking for Allah's blessings upon the Prophet pbuh
items.text: وَقَالَ صلى الله عليه وسلم: ((مَا مِنْ أَحَدٍ يُسَلِّمُ عَلَيَّ إِلاَّ رَدَّ اللَّهُ عَلَيَّ رُوحِيَ حَتَّى أَرُدَّ عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمَ)).
items.footnote: أبو داود برقم 2041وحسنه الألباني في صحيح أبي داود 1/ 383
items.translation: The Prophet [PBUH] said: 'No one sends greetings (or prayers of peace) upon me but Allah returns my soul to me so that I may return his greetings

items.sectionEn: Congratulations for new parents and how they should respond
items.text: ((بَارَكَ اللَّهُ لَكَ فِي الْمَوْهُوبِ لَكَ، وَشَكَرْتَ الْوَاهِبَ، وَبَلَغَ أَشُدَّهُ، وَرُزِقْتَ بِرَّهُ)). وَيَرُدُّ عَلَيْهِ الْمُهَنَّأُ فَيَقُولُ: ((بَارَكَ اللَّهُ لَكَ وَبَارَكَ عَلَيْكَ، وَجَزَاكَ اللَّهُ خَيْراً، وَرَزَقَكَ اللَّهُ مِثْلَهُ، وَأَجْزَلَ ثَوَابَكَ)).
items.footnote: انظر الأذكار للنووي ص349 وصحيح الأذكار للنووي ، لسليم الهلالي 2/713
items.translation: May Allah bless you with His gift to you and may you (the new parent) give thanks, may the child reach the maturity of years, and may you be granted its righteousness. The reply of the person being congratulated is to say: May Allah bless you, and shower His blessings upon you, and may Allah reward you well and bestow upon you its like and reward you abundantly
items.transliteration: Baarakallaahu laka fil-mawhoobi laka, wa shakartal-waahiba, wa balagha 'ashuddahu, wa ruzigta birrahu. The reply of the person being congratulated is to say: Baarakallahu laka wa baaraka 'alayka, wa jazaakallaahu khayran, wa razaqakallaahu mithlahu, wa 'ajzala thawaabaka.

items.sectionEn: How to seek Allah's protection for children
items.text: كَانَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يُعَوِّذُ الحَسَنَ وَالحُسَينَ رضي الله عنهما ((أُعِيذُكُمَا بِكَلِمَاتِ اللَّهِ التَّامَّةِ مِنْ كُلِّ شَيْطَانٍ وَهَامَّةٍ، وَمِنْ كُلِّ عَيْنٍ لاَمَّةٍ)).
items.footnote: البخاري 4/119 من حديث ابن عباس رضي الله عنهما
items.translation: (Ibn AAabbas related that the Messenger of Allah used to commend Al-Hasan and Al-Husayn to Allah’s protection, saying:(I commend you two to the protection of Allah’s perfect words from every devil, vermin, and every evil eye.))
items.transliteration: (Ibn AAabbas related that the Messenger of Allah used to commend Al-Hasan and Al-Husayn to Allah’s protection, saying:(OAAeethukuma bikalimatil-lahit-tammah, min kulli shaytanin wahammah, wamin kulli AAaynin lammah.))

items.sectionEn: Invocations for visiting the sick
items.text: ((لاَ بأْسَ طَهُورٌ إِنْ شَاءَ اللَّهُ)).
items.footnote: البخاري مع الفتح 10/ 118
items.translation: (Never mind, may it (the sickness) be a purification, if Allah wills.)
items.transliteration: (La ba'sa tahoorun in shaal-lah.)

items.sectionEn: Invocations for visiting the sick
items.text: ((أَسْأَلُ اللَّهَ الْعَظيمَ رَبَّ الْعَرْشِ الْعَظِيمِ أَنْ يَشْفيَكَ)) (سبع مرات).
items.footnote: ما من عبد مسلم يعود مريضاً لم يحضر أجله فيقول: سبع مرات.....الحديث إلا عوفي . أخرجه الترمذي وأبو داود وانظر صحيح الترمذي2/ 210 وصحيح الجامع 5/180
items.translation: (I ask Allah The Supreme, Lord of the magnificent throne to cure you’.(7times) (he (the sick person) will be cured.))
items.transliteration: (Asalul-lahal-AAatheem rabbal-AAarshil-AAatheem an yashfeek (7times).)

items.sectionEn: The reward for visiting the sick
items.text: قَالَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم: ((إِذَا عَادَ الرَّجُلُ أَخَاهُ الْمُسْلِمَ مَشَى فِي خِرَافَةِ الْجَنَّةِ حَتَّى يَجْلِسَ، فَإِذَا جَلَسَ غَمَرَتْهُ الرَّحْمَةُ، فَإِنْ كَانَ غُدْوَةً صَلَّى عَلَيْهِ سَبْعُونَ أَلْفَ مَلَكٍ حَتَّى يُمْسِيَ، وَإِنْ كَانَ مَسَاءً صَلَّى عَلَيْهِ سَبْعُونَ أَلْفَ مَلَكٍ حَتَّى يُصْبِحَ)).
items.footnote: رواه الترمذي وابن ماجه وأحمد وانظر صحيح ابن ماجه 1/244 وصحيح الترمذي 1/286 وصححه أيضاً أحمد شاكر
items.translation: (Ali Ibn Abee Talib related that he heard the Messenger of Allah say: ‘If a man calls on his sick Muslim brother, it is as if he walks reaping the fruits of Paradise until he sits, and when he sits he is showered in mercy, and if this was in the morning, seventy thousand angles send prayers upon him until the evening, and if this was in the evening, seventy thousand angles send prayers upon him until the morning.)

items.sectionAr: دعاء المريض الذي يئس من حياته
items.sectionEn: Invocations of the terminal ill
items.text: ((اللَّهُمَّ اغْفِرْ لِي، وَارْحَمْنِي، وَأَلْحِقْنِي بِالرَّفِيقِ الْأَعْلَى)).
items.footnote: البخاري 7/10 ومسلم 4/1893
items.translation: ‘O Allaah, forgive me, have mercy upon me and unite me with the highest companions
items.transliteration: (Allahummagh-fir lee, warhamnee wa-alhiqnee birrafeeqil-aAAla.)

items.sectionAr: دعاء المريض الذي يئس من حياته
items.sectionEn: Invocations of the terminal ill
items.text: ((جَعَلَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم عِنْدَ مَوْتِهِ يُدْخِلُ يَدَيْهِ فِي الْمَاءِ فَيَمْسَحُ بِهِمَا وَجْهَهُ، وَيَقُولُ: لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ اللَّهُ إِنَّ لِلْمَوْتِ سَكَرَاتٍ)).
items.footnote: البخاري مع الفتح 8/144وفي الحديث السواك
items.translation: 'Aa.ishah (radhi-yAllaahu 'anhaa) related that The Prophet (sal-Allaahu 'alayhe wa sallam) [during his illness in which he passed away] would dip his hands in water and then he would wipe his face and say: ‘None has the right to be worshipped except Allaah, death does indeed contain agony.’
items.transliteration: 'Aa.ishah (radhi-yAllaahu 'anhaa) related that The Prophet (sal-Allaahu 'alayhe wa sallam) [during his illness in which he passed away] would dip his hands in water and then he would wipe his face and say:[La ilaha illal-lah, inna lilmawti lasakarat.] ‘None has the right to be worshipped except Allaah, death does indeed contain agony.’

items.sectionAr: دعاء المريض الذي يئس من حياته
items.sectionEn: Invocations of the terminal ill
items.text: ((لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ اللَّهُ وَاللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ، لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ اللَّهُ وَحْدَهُ، لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ اللَّهُ وَحْدَهُ لاَ شَرِيكَ لَهُ، لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ اللَّهُ لَهُ المُلْكُ وَلَهُ الْحَمْدُ، لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ اللَّهُ وَلاَ حَوْلَ وَلاَ قُوَّةَ إِلاَّ بِاللَّهِ)).
items.footnote: أخرجه الترمذي وابن ماجه وصححه الألباني ، وانظر صحيح الترمذي 3/152وصحيح ابن ماجه 2/317
items.translation: (None has the right to be worshipped except Allah and Allah is the greatest.None has the right to be worshipped except Allah, alone.None has the right to be worshipped except Allah, alone, without partner.None has the right to be worshipped except Allah, to Him belongs all sovereignty and praise. None has the right to be worshipped except Allah and there is no might and no power except with Allah.)
items.transliteration: (La ilaha illal-lah, wallahu akbar, la ilaha illal-lahu wahdah, la shareeka lah, la ilaha illal-lahu lahul-mulku walahul-hamd, la ilaha illal-lah, wala hawla wala quwwata illa billah.)

items.sectionEn: What to encourage the dying person to say
items.text: ((مَنْ كَانَ آخِرُ كَلاَمِهِ لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ اللَّهُ دَخَلَ الْجَنَّةَ)).
items.footnote: أبو داود 3/190 وانظر صحيح الجامع 5/432
items.translation: i.e. those around the sick should instruct and encourage him to say the shahadah. (He whose last words are: (None has the right to be worshipped except Allah.) will enter Paradise.)
items.transliteration: i.e. those around the sick should instruct and encourage him to say the shahadah. (He whose last words are: (La ilaha illal-lah.) will enter Paradise.)

items.sectionEn: Invocation for when tragedy strikes
items.text: ((إِنَّا لِلَّهِ وَإِنَّا إِلَيْهِ رَاجِعُونَ، اللَّهُمَّ أْجُرْنِي فِي مُصِيبَتِي، وَأَخْلِفْ لِي خَيْرَاً مِنْهَا)).
items.footnote: مسلم 2/632
items.translation: (To Allah we belong and unto Him is our return.O Allah, recompense me for my affliction and replace it for me with something better.)
items.transliteration: (Inna lillahi wa-inna ilayhi rajiAAoon, allahumma/- jurnee fee museebatee wakhluf lee khayran minha.)

items.sectionEn: Invocation for closing the eyes of the dead
items.text: ((اللَّهُمَّ اغْفِرْ لِفُلاَنٍ (بِاسْمِهِ) وَارْفَعْ دَرَجَتَهُ فِي الْمَهْدِيِّينَ، وَاخْلُفْهُ فِي عَقِبِهِ فِي الْغَابِرِينَ، وَاغْفِرْ لَنَا وَلَهُ يَا رَبَّ الْعَالَمِينَ، وَافْسَحْ لَهُ فِي قَبْرِهِ، وَنَوِّرْ لَهُ فِيهِ)).
items.footnote: مسلم 2/634
items.translation: (O Allah, forgive -here the name of the deceased is mentioned- and raise his rank among the rightly guided, and be a successor to whom he has left behind, and forgive us and him O Lord of the worlds. Make spacious his grave and illuminate it for him.)(A successor: one who succeeds another due to the latter’s absence or death. This is the correct meaning of the word khaleefah; thus, it is incorrect to believe that Adam is the khaleefah (vicegerent, as is commonly translated) of Allah on earth because Allah is never absent, and will never die. This supplication proves the correct understanding of this term and shows that Allah succeeds us and guards whom we leave behind when we die or are absent (also refer to supplication #198).)
items.transliteration: (Allahummagh-fir li-name the dead- warfaAA darajatahu fil-mahdiyyeen, wakhlufhu fee AAaqibihi fil-ghabireen, waghfir lana walahu ya rabbal-AAalameen wafsah lahu fee qabrih, wanawwir lahu feeh.)

items.sectionEn: Invocations for the dead in the Funeral prayer
items.text: ((اللَّهُمَّ اغْفِرْ لَهُ وَارْحَمْهُ، وَعَافِهِ، وَاعْفُ عَنْهُ، وَأَكْرِمْ نُزُلَهُ، وَوَسِّعْ مُدْخَلَهُ، وَاغْسِلْهُ بِالْمَاءِ وَالثَّلْجِ وَالْبَرَدِ، وَنَقِّهِ مِنَ الْخَطَايَا كَمَا نَقَّيْتَ الثَّوْبَ الأَبْيَضَ مِنَ الدَّنَسِ، وَأَبْدِلْهُ دَاراً خَيْراً مِنْ دَارِهِ، وَأَهْلاً خَيْراً مِنْ أَهْلِهِ، وَزَوْجَاً خَيْراً مِنْ زَوْجِهِ، وَأَدْخِلْهُ الْجَنَّةَ، وَأَعِذْهُ مِنْ عَذَابِ القَبْرِ [وَعَذَابِ النَّارِ])).
items.footnote: مسلم 2/663
items.translation: (O Allah, forgive and have mercy upon him, excuse him and pardon him, and make honourable his reception. Expand his entry, and cleanse him with water, snow, and ice, and purify him of sin as a white robe is purified of filth. Exchange his home for a better home, and his family for a better family, and his spouse for a better spouse. Admit him into the Garden, protect him from the punishment of the grave and the torment of the Fire.)
items.transliteration: (Allahummagh-fir lahu warhamh, waAAafihi, waAAfu AAanh, wa-akrim nuzulah, wawassiAA mudkhalah, waghsilhu bilma-i waththalji walbarad, wanaqqihi minal-khataya kama naqqaytath-thawbal-abyada minad-danas, wa-abdilhu daran khayran min darih, wa-ahlan khayran min ahlih wazawjan khayran min zawjih, wa-adkhilhul-jannah, wa-aAAithhu min AAathabil-qabr, waAAathabin-nar)

items.sectionEn: Invocations for the dead in the Funeral prayer
items.text: ((اللَّهُمَّ اغْفِرْ لِحَيِّنَا وَمَيِّتِنَا، وَشَاهِدِنَا وَغَائِبِنَا، وَصَغِيرِنَا وَكَبيرِنَا، وَذَكَرِنَا وَأُنْثَانَا. اللَّهُمَّ مَنْ أَحْيَيْتَهُ مِنَّا فَأَحْيِهِ عَلَى الْإِسْلاَمِ، وَمَنْ تَوَفَّيْتَهُ مِنَّا فَتَوَفَّهُ عَلَى الإِيمَانِ، اللَّهُمَّ لاَ تَحْرِمْنَا أَجْرَهُ، وَلاَ تُضِلَّنَا بَعْدَهُ)).
items.footnote: ابن ماجه 1/480 وأحمد 2/368 وانظر صحيح ابن ماجة1/ 251
items.translation: (O Allah, forgive our living and our dead, those present and those absent, our young and our old, our males and our females. O Allah, whom amongst us You keep alive, then let such a life be upon Islam, and whom amongst us You take unto Yourself, then let such a death be upon faith. O Allah, do not deprive us of his reward and do not let us stray after him.)
items.transliteration: (Allahummagh-fir lihayyina wamayyitina washahidina, wagha-ibina, wasagheerina wakabeerina, wathakarina wa-onthana. Allahumma man ahyaytahu minna fa-ahyihi AAalal-islam, waman tawaffaytahu minna fatawaffahu AAalal-eeman, allahumma la tahrimna ajrah, wala tudillana baAAdah.)

items.sectionEn: Invocations for the dead in the Funeral prayer
items.text: ((اللَّهُمَّ إِنَّ فُلاَنَ بْنَ فُلاَنٍ فِي ذِمَّتِكَ، وَحَبْلِ جِوَارِكَ، فَقِهِ مِنْ فِتْنَةِ الْقَبْرِ، وَعَذَابِ النَّارِ، وَأَنْتَ أَهْلُ الْوَفَاءِ وَالْحَقِّ، فَاغْفِرْ لَهُ وَارْحَمْهُ إِنَّكَ أَنْتَ الغَفُورُ الرَّحيمُ)).
items.footnote: أخرجه ابن ماجه ، وانظر صحيح ابن ماجة1/ 251ورواه أبو داود 3/211
items.translation: (O Allah, so-and-so is under Your care and protection so protect him from the trial of the grave and torment of the Fire. Indeed You are faithful and truthful. Forgive and have mercy upon him, surely You are The Oft-Forgiving, The Most-Merciful.)
items.transliteration: (Allahumma inna -name the dead- fee thimmatik, wahabli jiwarik, faqihi min fitnatil-qabr waAAathabin-nar, wa-anta ahlul-wafa/, walhaq, faghfir lahu warhamh, innaka antal-ghafoorur-raheem.)

items.sectionEn: Invocations for the dead in the Funeral prayer
items.text: ((اللَّهُمَّ عَبْدُكَ وَابْنُ أَمَتِكَ احْتَاجَ إِلَى رَحْمَتِكَ، وَأَنْتَ غَنِيٌّ عَنْ عَذَابِهِ، إِنْ كَانَ مُحْسِناً فَزِدْ فِي حَسَنَاتِهِ، وَإِنْ كَانَ مُسِيئاً فَتَجَاوَزْ عَنْهُ)).
items.footnote: أخرجه الحاكم وصححه ووافقه الذهبي 1/359 وانظر أحكام الجنائز للألباني ص125
items.translation: (O Allah, Your servant and the son of Your maidservant is in need of Your mercy and You are without need of his punishment. If he was righteous then increase his reward and if he was wicked then look over his sins.)
items.transliteration: (Allahumma AAabduka wabnu amatik, ihtaja ila rahmatik, wa-anta ghaniyyun AAan AAathabih, in kana muhsinan fazid fee hasanatih, wa-in kana museean fatajawaz AAanh.)

items.sectionEn: Invocations for a child in the Funeral prayer
items.text: ((اللَّهُمَّ أَعِذْهُ مِنْ عَذَابِ القَبْرِ)) وإن قال: ((اللَّهُمَّ اجْعَلْهُ فَرَطاً وَذُخْراً لِوَالِدَيْهِ، وَشَفِيعاً مُجَاباً، اللَّهُمَّ ثَقِّلْ بِهِ مَوَازِينَهُمَا، وَأَعْظِمْ بِهِ أُجورَهُمَا، وَأَلْحِقْهُ بِصَالِحِ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ، وَاجْعَلْهُ فِي كَفَالَةِ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، وَقِهِ بِرَحْمَتِكَ عَذَابَ الْجَحِيمِ، وَأَبْدِلْهُ دَاراً خَيْراً مِنْ دَارِهِ، وَأَهْلاً خَيْراً مِنْ أَهْلِهِ، اللَّهُمَّ اغْفِرْ لِأَسْلاَفِنَا، وَأَفْرَاطِنَا، وَمَنْ سَبَقَنَا بِالْإِيمَانِ)) إن قال ذلك فَحَسَنٌ.
items.footnote:
قال سعيد بن المسيب صليت وراء أبي هريرة على صبي لم يعمل خطيئة قط فسمعته يقول ... الحديث .أخرجه مالك في الموطأ 1/288 وابن أبي شيبه في المصنف 3/ 217 والبيهقي 4/9، وصحح إسناده شعيب الأرناؤوط في تحقيقه لشرح السنة للبغوي 5/357
انظر : المغني لابن قدامة 3/416 والدروس المهمة لعامة الأمة للشيخ عبد العزيز بن عبد الله بن باز حفظه الله ص15
items.translation: O Allah, protect him from the torment of the grave . [it is also good to say] O Allah, make him a precursor, a forerunner and a treasure for his parents and an answered intercessor. O Allah, make him weigh heavily in their scales (of good) and magnify their reward. Make him join the righteous of the believers. Place him in the care of Ibrahim. Save him by Your mercy from the torment of Hell. Give him a home better than his home and a family better than his family. O Allah, forgive those who have gone (i.e. passed away) before us, our children lost (by death), and those who have preceded us in Faith.
items.transliteration: (Allaahumma 'a'ith-hu min 'athaabil-qabri.) [or say:](Allahummaj-AAalhu faratan, wathukhran liwalidayh, washafeeAAan mujaban. Allahumma thaqqil bihi mawazeenahuma wa-aAAthim bihi ojoorahuma, wa-alhiqhu bisalihil-mu'mineen, wajAAalhu fee kafalati Ibraheem, waqihi birahmatika AAathabal-jaheem, wa 'abdilhu daaran khayran min daarihi, wa 'ahlan khayran min 'ahlihi, Allaahum-maghfir li'aslaafinaa, wa afraatinaa wa man sabaqanaa bil'eemaan)

items.sectionEn: Invocations for a child in the Funeral prayer
items.text: ((اللَّهُمَّ اجْعَلْهُ لَنَا فَرَطاً، وَسَلَفاً، وَأَجْراً)).
items.footnote: كان الحسن يقرأ على الطفل بفاتحة الكتاب ويقول .. الحديث أخرجه البغوي في شرح السنة 5/357وعبد الرزاق برقم 6588، وعلقه البخاري في كتاب الجنائز ، 65باب قراءة فاتحة الكتاب على الجنازة 2/113
items.translation: (O Allah, make him for us a precursor,a forerunner and a cause of reward)
items.transliteration: (Allahummaj-AAalhu lana farata, wasalafan wa-ajra.)

items.sectionEn: Invocation for the bereaved
items.text: ((إِنَّ للَّهِ مَا أَخَذَ، وَلَهُ مَا أَعْطَى، وَكُلُّ شَيْءٍ عِنْدَهُ بِأَجَلٍ مُسَمَّى... فَلْتَصْبِرْ وَلْتَحْتَسِبْ)). وَإِنْ قَالَ: ((أَعْظَمَ اللَّهُ أَجْرَكَ، وَأَحْسَنَ عَزَاءَكَ، وَغَفَرَ لِمَيِّتِكَ)) فَحَسَنٌ.
items.footnote:
البخاري 2/80 ومسلم 2/636
الأذكار للنووي ص126
items.translation: (Verily to Allah, belongs what He took and to Him belongs what He gave, and everything with Him has an appointed time…and then he ordered for her to be patient and hope for Allah’s reward.)(The words (faltasbir waltahtasib) are commands in the feminine 3rd person form, so they will need to be changed in respect to whom is being addressed.)
items.transliteration: (Inna lillahi ma akhath, walahu ma aAAta, wakullu shayin AAindahu bi-ajalin musamma…faltasbir waltahtasib.)

items.sectionEn: Invocation to be recited when placing the dead in his grave
items.text: ((بِسْمِ اللَّهِ وَعَلَى سُنَّةِ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ)).
items.footnote: أبو داود 3/314بسند صحيح وأحمد بلفظ بسم الله وعلى ملة رسول الله وسنده صحيح
items.translation: (In the name of Allah and upon the sunnah of the Messenger of Allah.)
items.transliteration: (Bismil-lahi waAAala sunnati rasoolil-lah.)

items.sectionEn: Invocation to be recited after burying the dead
items.text: ((اللَّهُمَّ اغْفِرْ لَهُ، اللَّهُمَّ ثَبِّتْهُ)).
items.footnote: كان النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم إذا فرغ من دفن الميت وقف عليه فقال : استغفروا لأخيكم وسلوا له التثبيت فإنه الآن يُسأل .أبو داود 3/315 والحاكم وصححه ووافقه الذهبي 1/370
items.translation: O Allah, forgive him. O Allah, strengthen him
items.transliteration: Allaahum-maghfir lahu Allaahumma thabbithu

items.sectionEn: Invocation for visiting the graves
items.text: ((السَّلاَمُ عَلَيْكُمْ أَهْلَ الدِّيَارِ، مِنَ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ وَالْمُسْلِمِينَ، وَإِنَّا إِنْ شَاءَ اللَّهُ بِكُمْ لاَحِقُونَ، [وَيَرْحَمُ اللَّهُ الْمُسْتَقدِمِينَ مِنَّا وَالْمُسْتأْخِرِينَ] أَسْاَلُ اللَّهَ لَنَا وَلَكُمُ الْعَافِيَةَ)).
items.footnote: سلمم2/671 ،وابن ماجه واللفظ له 1/494 عن بريدة رضي الله عنه ، وما بين المعكوفين من حديث عائشة رضي الله عنها عند مسلم 2/671
items.translation: (Peace be upon you all, O inhabitants of the graves, amongst the believers and the Muslims. Verily we will, Allah willing, be united with you, we ask Allah for well-being for us and you.)
items.transliteration: (Assalamu AAalaykum ahlad-diyari minal-mu/mineena walmuslimeen, wa-inna in shaal-lahu bikum lahiqoon, nas-alul-laha lana walakumul-AAafiyah.)

items.sectionEn: Invocations for when the wind blows
items.text: ((اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ خَيْرَهَا، وَأَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ شَرِّهَا)).
items.translation: (O Allah, I ask You for it’s goodness and I take refuge with You from it’s evil.)
items.transliteration: (Allahumma innee as-aluka khayraha wa-aAAoothu bika min sharriha.)

items.sectionEn: Invocations for when the wind blows
items.text: ((اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ خَيْرَهَا، وَخَيْرَ مَا فِيهَا، وَخَيْرَ مَا أُرْسِلَتْ بِهِ، وَأَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ شَرِّهَا، وَشَرِّ مَا فِيهَا، وَشَرِّ مَا أُرْسِلَتْ بِهِ)).
items.footnote:
أخرجه أبو داود 4/326وابن ماجه 2/1228 وانظر صحيح ابن ماجة2/ 305
مسلم 2/616 والبخاري 4/76
items.translation: (O Allah, I ask You for it’s goodness, the good within it, and the good it was sent with, and I take refuge with You from it’s evil, the evil within it, and from the evil it was sent with.)
items.transliteration: (Allahumma innee as-aluka khayraha wakhayra ma feeha, wakhayra ma orsilat bih, wa-aAAoothu bika min sharriha, washarri ma feeha washarri ma orsilat bih.)

items.sectionEn: Invocation for when it thunders
items.text: ((سُبْحَانَ الَّذِي يُسَبِّحُ الرَّعْدُ بِحَمْدِهِ وَالْمَلاَئِكةُ مِنْ خِيفَتِهِ)).
items.footnote: كان عبد الله بن الزبير رضي الله عنهما إذا سمع الرعد ترك الحديث وقال :.... الموطأ 2/992 وقال الألباني صحيح الإسناد موقوفاً
items.translation: (How perfect He is, (The One) Whom the thunder declares His perfection with His praise, as do the angles out of fear of Him.)
items.transliteration: (Subhanal-lathee yusabbihur-raAAdu bihamdih, walmala-ikatu min kheefatih.)

items.sectionEn: Some invocations for rain
items.text: ((اللَّهُمَّ اسْقِنَا غَيْثاً مُغِيثاً مَرِيئاً مَرِيعاً، نَافِعاً غَيْرَ ضَارٍّ، عَاجِلاً غَيْرَ آجِلٍ)).
items.footnote: أبو داود 1/303 وصححه الألباني في صحيح أبي داود1/ 216
items.translation: (O Allah, send upon us helpful, wholesome and healthy rain, beneficial not harmful rain, now, not later.)
items.transliteration: (Allahummas-qina ghaythan mugheethan maree-an mureeAAan, nafiAAan, ghayra dar, AAajilan ghayra ajil.)

items.sectionEn: Some invocations for rain
items.text: ((اللَّهُمَّ أَغِثْنَا، اللَّهُمَّ أَغِثْنَا، اللَّهُمَّ أَغِثْنَا)).
items.footnote: والبخاري 1/224 ،مسلم 2/613
items.translation: (O Allah, relieve us, O Allah, relieve us, O Allah, relieve us.)
items.transliteration: (Allahumma aghithna, allahumma aghithna, allahumma aghithna.)

items.sectionEn: Some invocations for rain
items.text: ((اللَّهُمَّ اسْقِ عِبَادَكَ، وَبَهَائِمَكَ، وَانْشُرْ رَحْمَتَكَ، وَأَحْيِي بَلَدَكَ الْمَيِّتَ)).
items.footnote: أبو داود 1/305 وحسنه الألباني في صحيح أبي داود1/ 218
items.translation: (O Allah, provide water for Your servants and Your cattle, spread out Your mercy and resurrect Your dead land.)
items.transliteration: (Allahummas-qi AAibadak, wabaha-imak, wanshur rahmatak, wa-ahyi baladakal-mayyit.)

items.sectionEn: Invocation for when it rains
items.text: ((اللَّهُمَّ صَيِّباً نَافِعاً)).
items.footnote: البخاري مع الفتح 2/518
items.translation: (O Allah, may it be a beneficial rain cloud.)
items.transliteration: (Allahumma sayyiban nafiAAa.)

items.sectionEn: Supplication after it rains
items.text: ((مُطِرْنَا بِفَضْلِ اللَّهِ وَرَحْمَتِهِ)).
items.footnote: والبخاري 1/205 ،مسلم 1/83
items.translation: (We have been given rain by the grace and mercy of Allah.)
items.transliteration: (Mutirna bifadlil-lahi warahmatih.)

items.sectionEn: Invocation for the withholding of the rain
items.text: ((اللَّهُمَّ حَوَالَيْنَا وَلاَ عَلَيْنَا، اللَّهُمَّ عَلَى الآكَامِ وَالظِّرَابِ، وَبُطُونِ الْأَوْدِيَةِ، وَمَنَابِتِ الشَّجَرِ)).
items.footnote: والبخاري 1/224 ،مسلم 2/614
items.translation: (O Allah, let the rain fall around us and not upon us, O Allah, (let it fall) on the pastures, hills, valleys and the roots of trees.)
items.transliteration: (Allahumma hawalayna wala AAalayna, allahumma AAalal-akami waththirab, wabutoonil-awdiyah, wamanabitish-shajar.)

items.sectionEn: Invocation for sighting the new moon
items.text: ((اللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ، اللَّهُمَّ أَهِلَّهُ عَلَيْنَا بِالْأَمْنِ وَالْإِيمَانِ، وَالسَّلاَمَةِ وَالْإِسْلاَمِ، وَالتَّوْفِيقِ لِمَا تُحِبُّ رَبَّنَا وَتَرْضَى، رَبُّنَا وَرَبُّكَ اللَّهُ)).
items.footnote: الترمذي 5/504 والدارمي بلفظه 1/336 وانظر صحيح الترمذي3/ 157
items.translation: (Allah is the greatest. O Allah, let the crescent loom above us in safety, faith, peace, and Islam, and in agreement with all that You love and pleases You. Our Lord and your Lord is Allah.)
items.transliteration: (Allahu akbar, allahumma ahillahu AAalayna bil-amni wal-eeman, wassalamati wal-islam, wattawfeeiqi lima tuhibbu watarda, rabbuna warabbukal-lah.)

items.sectionEn: Invocation for sneezing
items.text: ((إِذَا عَطَسَ أَحَدُكُم فَلْيَقُلِ الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ، وَلْيَقُلْ لَهُ أَخُوهُ أَوْ صَاحِبُهُ: يَرْحَمُكَ اللَّهُ، فَإِذَا قَالَ لَهُ: يَرحَمُكَ اللَّهُ، فَلْيَقُلْ: يَهْدِيكُمُ اللَّهُ وَيُصْلِحُ بَالَكُمْ)).
items.footnote: البخاري 7/125
items.translation: (When one of you sneezes he should say:(All praise if for Allah.) and his brother or companion should say to him: (May Allah have mercy upon you.) and he (i.e. the one who sneezed) replies back to him:(May Allah guide you and rectify your condition.))
items.transliteration: (When one of you sneezes he should say:(Alhamdu lillah.) and his brother or companion should say to him: (Yarhamukal-lah.) and he (i.e. the one who sneezed) replies back to him:(Yahdeekumul-lahu wayuslihu balakum.))

items.sectionAr: ما يقال للكافر إذا عطس فحمد الله
items.sectionEn: What to say to the disbeliever if he sneezes and praises Allah
items.text: ((يَهْدِيكُمُ اللَّهُ وَيُصْلِحُ بَالَكُمْ)).
items.footnote: الترمذي 5/82 وأحمد 4/400 وأبو داود 4/308، وانظر صحيح الترمذي 2/354
items.translation: (May Allah guide you and rectify your condition.)
items.transliteration: (Yahdeekum wayuslihu balakum.)

items.sectionEn: Invocation for the groom
items.text: ((بَارَكَ اللَّهُ لَكَ، وَبَارَكَ عَلَيْكَ، وَجَمَعَ بَيْنَكُمَا فِي خَيْرٍ)).
items.footnote: أخرجه أصحاب السنن إلا النسائي وانظر صحيح الترمذي 1/316
items.translation: (May Allah bless for you (your spouse) and bless you, and may He unite both of you in goodness.)
items.transliteration: (Barakal-lahu lak, wabaraka AAalayk, wajamaAAa baynakuma fee khayr.)

items.sectionEn: The groom’s supplication on the wedding night or when buying an animal
items.text: إِذَا تَزَوَّجَ أَحَدُكُمُ امْرَأَةً، أَوْ إِذَا اشْتَرَى خَادِماً فَلْيَقُلْ: ((اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ خَيْرَهَا، وَخَيْرَ مَا جَبَلْتَهَا عَلَيْهِ، وَأَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ شَرِّهَا، وَشَرِّ مَا جَبَلْتَهَا عَلَيْهِ، وَإِذَا اشْتَرَى بَعِيراً فَلْيَأْخُذْ بِذِرْوَةِ سَنَامِهِ وَلْيَقُلْ مِثْلَ ذَلِكَ)).
items.footnote: أبو داود 2/248 وابن ماجه 1/617 وانظر صحيح ابن ماجه 1/324
items.translation: (when you marry a woman or buy a maidservant, you should say:(O Allah, I ask You for the goodness within her and the goodness that you have made her inclined towards, and I take refuge with You from the evil within her and the evil that you have made her inclined towards.))(and if you buy a camel, then you should take hold of it’s hump and say likewise.)
items.transliteration: (when you marry a woman or buy a maidservant, you should say: (Allahumma innee as-aluka khayraha wakhayra ma jabaltaha AAalayh, wa-aAAoothu bika min sharriha washarri ma jabaltaha AAalayh.))(and if you buy a camel, then you should take hold of it’s hump and say likewise.)

items.sectionEn: Invocation to be recited before intercourse
items.text: ((بِسْمِ اللَّهِ، اللَّهُمَّ جَنِّبْنَا الشَّيْطَانَ، وَجَنِّبِ الشَّيْطَانَ مَا رَزَقْتَنَا)).
items.footnote: البخاري 6/141 ومسلم 2/1028
items.translation: (In the name of Allah. O Allah, keep the devil away from us and keep the devil away from what you have blessed us with.)
items.transliteration: (Bismil-lah, allahumma jannibnash-shaytan, wajannibish-shaytana ma razaqtana.)

items.sectionEn: Invocation for anger
items.text: ((أَعُوذُ بِاللَّهِ مِنَ الشَّيْطَانِ الرَّجِيمِ)).
items.footnote: البخاري 6/99 ومسلم4/2015
items.translation: (I take refuge with Allah from the accursed devil.)
items.transliteration: (aAAoothu billahi minash-shaytanir-rajeem.)

items.sectionEn: What to say if you see someone afflicted by misfortune
items.text: ((الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ الَّذِي عَافَانِي مِمَّا ابْتَلاَكَ بِهِ، وَفَضَّلَنِي عَلَى كَثِيرٍ مِمَّنْ خَلَقَ تَفْضِيلاً)).
items.footnote: الترمذي 5/494 و5/493 وانظر صحيح الترمذي3/ 153
items.translation: (All praise is for Allah Who saved me from that which He tested you with and Who most certainly favoured me over much of His creation.)
items.transliteration: (Alhamdu lillahil-lathee AAafanee mimmab-talaka bih, wafaddalanee AAala katheerin mimman khalaqa tafdeela.)

items.sectionEn: What to say while sitting in an assembly
items.text: ((عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ رضي الله عنه قَاَلَ: كَانَ يُعَدُّ لِرَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فِي الْمَجْلِسِ الوَاحِدِ مِائَةُ مَرَّةٍ مِنْ قَبْلِ أَنْ يَقُومَ: ((رَبِّ اغْفِرْ لِي، وَتُبْ عَلَيَّ، إِنَّكَ أَنْتَ التَّوَّابُ الغَفُورُ)).
items.footnote: الترمذي وغيره وانظر صحيح الترمذي 3/153 وصحيح ابن ماجه 2/321 ولفظه للترمذي
items.translation: (Ibn AAumar said: It would be counted that the Messenger of Allah would say one hundred times at any one sitting before getting up: (O my Lord, forgive me and turn towards me (to accept my repentance). Verily You are The Oft-Returning. The Oft-Forgiving.))
items.transliteration: (Ibn AAumar said: It would be counted that the Messenger of Allah would say one hundred times at any one sitting before getting up: (Rabbigh-fir lee watub AAalay, innaka antat-tawwabul-ghafoor.))

items.sectionEn: The Expiation of Assembly - Kaffaratul-Majlis
items.text: ((سُبْحَانَكَ اللَّهُمَّ وَبِحَمْدِكَ، أَشْهَدُ أَنْ لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ أَنْتَ، أَسْتَغْفِرُكَ وَأَتُوبُ إِلَيْكَ)).
items.footnote: أخرجه أصحاب السنن وانظر صحيح الترمذي 3/153، وقد ثبت عن عائشة رضي الله عنها قالت :ما جلس رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم مجلساً ، ولاتلى قرآناً ، ولا صلاة إلا ختم ذلك بكلمات.... الحديث أخرجه النسائي في عمل اليوم والليلة برقم 308 ، وأحمد 6/77 وصححه الدكتور فاروق حمادة في تحقيقه لعمل اليوم والليلة للنسائي ص273
items.translation: (How perfect You are O Allah, and I praise You. I bear witness that None has the right to be worshipped except You. I seek Your forgiveness and turn to You in repentance.)
items.transliteration: (Subhanakal-lahumma wabihamdik, ashhadu an la ilaha illa ant, astaghfiruka wa-atoobu ilayk.)

items.sectionAr: الدعاء لمن قال غفر الله لك
items.sectionEn: Invocation for someone who says: May Allah forgive you
items.text: ولك
items.footnote: أحمد 5/28 والنسائي في عمل اليوم والليلة ص218برقم 421 تحقيق الدكتور فاروق حمادة
items.source: rn0x:الدعاء لمن قال غفر الله لك

items.sectionEn: InInvocation for someone who does good to you
items.text: ((جَزَاكَ اللَّهُ خَيْراً)).
items.footnote: أخرجه الترمذي رقم 2035 وانظر صحيح الجامع 6244 وصحيح الترمذي2/ 200
items.translation: (If someone does you a favour and you say: (May Allah reward you with goodness.) then you have indeed excelled in praising him.)
items.transliteration: (If someone does you a favour and you say: (Jazakal-lahu khayran.) then you have indeed excelled in praising him.)

items.sectionAr: ما يعصم الله به من الدجال
items.sectionEn: Invocation for Allah's protection from the False Messiah
items.text: ((مَنْ حَفِظَ عَشْرَ آيَاتٍ مِنْ أَوَّلِ سُورَةِ الْكَهْفِ عُصِمَ مِنَ الدَّجَّالِ)) ، وَالْاسْتِعَاذَةُ بِاللَّهِ مِنْ فِتْنَتِهِ عَقِبَ التَّشَهُّدِ الْأَخِيرِ مِنْ كُلِّ صَلاَةٍ.
items.footnote: مسلم 1/555 وفي رواية من آخر الكهف 1/556
items.translation: (Dajjal: among the great signs of the last hour and the greatest trials to befall mankind, which every Prophet has warned about. Most of mankind will folow him. He will appear from Asbahan, Iran at the time when Muslims will conquer Constantinople. He will be given special powers and will make the truth seem false and vice versa. He will claim to be righteous and then he will claim prophet-hood and finally, divinity. From his features is that he will be blind in his right eye which is a definite proof that contradicts his claim to be Allah as it is a sign of imperfection. The word Kafir will be written between his eyes which every believer, literate or illiterate will recognise.)(Whoever memorises the first ten verses of soorat Al-Kahf will be protected from Dajjal.)(One should also seek refuge with Allah from the tribulations of the Dajjal after the last tashahhud in prayer.(Refer to supplications #55 & #56))

items.sectionAr: الدعاء لمن قال إني أحبك في الله
items.sectionEn: InInvocation for someone who tells you I love you for the sake of Allah
items.text: ((أَحَبَّكَ الَّذِي أَحْبَبْتَنِي لَهُ)).
items.footnote: أخرجه أبو داود 4/333، وحسنه الألباني في صحيح سنن أبي داود 3/965
items.translation: (May He, for whom you have loved me, love you.)
items.transliteration: (Ahabbakal-lathee ahbabtanee lah.)

items.sectionEn: InInvocation for someone who offers you a share of his wealth
items.text: ((بَارَكَ اللَّهُ لَكَ فِي أَهْلِكَ وَمَالِكَ)).
items.footnote: البخاري الفتح4/ 88
items.translation: (May Allah bless for you, your family and wealth.)
items.transliteration: (Barakal-lahu laka fee ahlika wamalik.)

items.sectionEn: Invocation (upon receipt of the loan) for someone who lends you money
items.text: ((بارَكَ اللَّهُ لَكَ فِي أَهْلِكَ وَمَالِكَ، إِنَّمَا جَزَاءُ السَّلَفِ الْحَمْدُ وَالأَدَاءُ)).
items.footnote: أخرجه النسائي في عمل اليوم والليلة ص 300 وابن ماجه 2/ 809 وانظر صحيح ابن ماجه 2/809 وانظر صحيح ابن ماجه 2/55
items.translation: (May Allah bless for you, your family and wealth. Surely commendation and payment are the reward for a loan.)
items.transliteration: (Barakal-lahu laka fee ahlika wamalik, innama jaza-os-salafil-hamdu wal-ada'.)

items.sectionEn: Invocation for fear of Shirk
items.text: ((اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِكَ أَنْ أُشْرِكَ بِكَ وَأَنَا أَعْلَمُ، وَأَسْتَغْفِرُكَ لِمَا لاَ أَعْلَمُ)).
items.footnote: أحمد 4/403 وغيره وانظر صحيح الجامع 3/333 وصحيح الترغيب والترهيب للألباني
items.translation: (shirk: to associate others with Allah in those things which are specific to Him. This can occur in (1) belief, e.g. to believe that other than Allah has the power to benefit or harm, (2) speech, e.g. to swear by other than Allah and (3) action, e.g. to bow or prostrate to other than Allah.)(O Allah, I take refuge in You lest I should commit shirk with You knowingly and I seek Your forgiveness for what I do unknowingly.)
items.transliteration: (shirk: to associate others with Allah in those things which are specific to Him. This can occur in (1) belief, e.g. to believe that other than Allah has the power to benefit or harm, (2) speech, e.g. to swear by other than Allah and (3) action, e.g. to bow or prostrate to other than Allah.)(Allahumma innee aAAoothu bika an oshrika bika wa-ana aAAlam, wa-astaghfiruka lima la aAAlam.)

items.sectionAr: الدعاء لمن قال بارك الله فيك
items.sectionEn: InInvocation for someone who tells you: May Allah bless you
items.text: ((وَفِيكَ بَارَكَ اللَّهُ)).
items.footnote: أخرجه ابن السني ص138 برقم 278 وانظر الوابل الصيب لابن القيم 304 تحقيق بشير محمد عيون
items.translation: (Aaishah reported that the Messenger of Allah was given a sheep and he ordered for it’s distribution. When the servant would come back (from distributing it), AAaishah would ask: ‘What did they say?’, he replied: They would supplicate: (May Allah bless you all.) AAaishah would then say: (and may Allah bless them.))(we return their supplication in a similar way and our reward remains with us.)
items.transliteration: (Aaishah reported that the Messenger of Allah was given a sheep and he ordered for it’s distribution. When the servant would come back (from distributing it), AAaishah would ask: ‘What did they say?’, he replied: They would supplicate: (Barakal-lahu feekum.) AAaishah would then say: (Wafeehim barakal-lah.))(we return their supplication in a similar way and our reward remains with us.)

items.sectionEn: Invocation against evil portent
items.text: ((اللَّهُمَّ لاَ طَيْرَ إِلاَّ طَيْرُكَ، وَلاَ خَيْرَ إِلاَّ خَيْرُكَ، وَلاَ إِلَهَ غَيْرُكَ)).
items.footnote: أحمد 2/220 وابن السني برقم 292 وصححه الألباني في الأحاديث الصحيحة 3/54 رقم 1065 ، أما الفأل فكان يعجب النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم ؛ ولهذا سمع من رجل كلمة طيبة فأعجبته فقال : أخذنا فألك من فيك أبو داود وأحمد ،وصححه الألباني في الصحيحة2/363 عند أبي الشيخ في أخلاق النبي
items.translation: (This supplication is used whenever one initially thinks a casual event or occurrence to foretell good or evil, using it as a basis to determine which action he should undertake, but he then denounces such a link, relies on Allah and then says this supplication as an expiation for this act, since it falls under the category of shirk.)(O Allah, there is no omen but there is reliance on You, there is no good except Your good and none has the right to be worshipped except You.)
items.transliteration: (This supplication is used whenever one initially thinks a casual event or occurrence to foretell good or evil, using it as a basis to determine which action he should undertake, but he then denounces such a link, relies on Allah and then says this supplication as an expiation for this act, since it falls under the category of shirk.)(Allahumma la tayra illa tayruk, wala khayra illa khayruk, wala ilaha ghayruk.)

items.sectionAr: ما يقول من أتاه أمر يسره أو يكرهه
items.sectionEn: What to say if something happens to please you or to displease you
items.text: كَانَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم إِذَا أَتَاهُ الْأَمْرُ يَسُرُّهُ قَالَ: ((الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ الَّذِي بِنِعْمَتِهِ تَتِمُّ الصَّالِحَاتُ)) وَإِذَا أَتَاهُ الْأَمْرُ يَكْرَهُهُ قَالَ: ((الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ عَلَى كُلِّ حَالٍ)).
items.footnote: أخرجه ابن السني في عمل اليوم والليلة والحاكم وصححه 1/499 وصححه الألباني في صحيح الجامع 4/ 201
items.translation: When something happened that pleased him, the Prophet used to say:((Alhamdu lillaahil-lathee bini'matihi tatimmuus-saalihaat)). Praise is to Allah Who by His blessings all good things are perfected. And if something happened that displeased him, he used to say:((Alhamdulillaahi 'alaa kulli haal)).Praise is to Allah in all circumstances.
items.transliteration: When something happened that pleased him, the Prophet used to say:((Alhamdu lillaahil-lathee bini'matihi tatimmuus-saalihaat)).And if something happened that displeased him, he used to say:((Alhamdulillaahi 'alaa kulli haal)).

items.sectionEn: spreading the greetings of Salam (Peace)
items.text: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم: ((لاَ تَدْخُلُوا الْجَنَّةَ حَتَّى تُؤْمِنُوا، وَلاَ تُؤْمِنُوا حَتَّى تَحَابُّوا، أَوَلاَ أَدُلُّكُم عَلَى شَيْءٍ إِذَا فَعَلْتُمُوهُ تَحَابَبْتُم، أَفْشُوا السَّلاَمَ بَيْنَكُمْ)).
items.footnote: مسلم 1/74 وغيره
items.translation: (The Messenger of Allah said: ‘You shall not enter paradise until you believe, and you shall not believe until you love one another. Shall I not inform you of something, if you were to act upon it, you will indeed achieve mutual love for one another? Spread the greeting amongst yourselves.)

items.sectionEn: spreading the greetings of Salam (Peace)
items.text: ((ثَلاَثٌ مَنْ جَمَعَهُنَّ فَقَدْ جَمَعَ الْإِيمَانَ: الْإِنْصَافُ مِنْ نَفْسِكَ، وَبَذْلُ السَّلاَمِ لِلْعَالَمِ، وَالْإِنْفَاقُ مِنَ الإِقْتَارِ)).
items.footnote: البخاري مع الفتح 1/ 82 عن عمار رضي الله عنه موقوفاً معلقاً
items.translation: (Aammar said: ‘Three characteristics, whoever combines them, has completed his faith: to be just, to spread greetings to all people and to spend (charitably) out of the little you have.)

items.sectionEn: spreading the greetings of Salam (Peace)
